  2. The ⊕ chamber carries no stress-energy. F+ cannot source the metric; it only selects which ⊗-layer modes are admissible. Any candidate that tries to extract forward-lobe energy "from the chamber" is committing the chamber-abuse first failure and is rejected before the source gate ever runs.

C3.3.2 How the layers feed the proper-distance functional (interface to C2)

The layer assignment is not abstract taxonomy; it determines how each component is allowed to influence the forward-distance score S_L defined in C2. The proper-distance functional L_F = ∫ √(g_ij dx^i dx^j) over the forward lobe F_τ(D,ρ) depends on the metric only. The layer discipline therefore enforces a strict causal chain:

⊗  (gauge δA^a, scalar δφ^I, graviphoton δG_μA, internal δG_AB, matter)
       │  contributes stress-energy T^{(⊗)}_μν   (must carry a ledger; HC-02 matches it)
       ▼
×  (metric δg_μν on M4)   via the Einstein interface  G_μν[δg] = M_Pl⁻² T^{(⊗)}_μν
       │  the ONLY layer that enters L_F directly
       ▼
S_L  (forward-distance shortening score, C2)
       ▲
⊕  (F+ chamber)  gates membership: a mode that leaves F+ is removed from the ensemble BEFORE S_L is computed

Three rules fall out, and each is a guard against a known cheat:

  1. A ⊗ component can affect S_L only by first sourcing δg_μν through the Einstein equation. It can never be injected directly into L_F. This blocks the "gauge field magically shortens distance without bending the metric" artifact — a ⊗ mode with T^{(⊗)}_μν = 0 contributes exactly zero to S_L, by construction.
  2. The internal metric blocks are × but frozen, so they contribute a constant to L_F (the same constant for every candidate, since the freeze hash pins them). They cannot create a difference in S_L between candidates — only the dynamical M4 block δg_μν can. This is why a modulus excitation is so dangerous: it is the one way to make the "constant" non-constant, which is exactly why it routes to UV_DELEGATED rather than being silently absorbed into the score.
  3. The ⊕ chamber acts before the integral, not inside it. It is a set-membership filter on the candidate ensemble. It has no metric content, so it contributes nothing to L_F and cannot be a source of shortening. A candidate that books "chamber energy" into S_L is double-counting a non-existent stress ledger.

This is the operational meaning of "no smuggling": the S_L a reviewer sees downstream is forced, by the layer graph, to be traceable to a ×-layer metric perturbation that is itself sourced by a ⊗-layer stress ledger the source gate (HC-02) can audit. Nothing reaches the score except through that chain.

First failure (this section): a component that lands in the else → UNASSIGNED branch; a ⊕ component asserting a stress ledger (chamber-as-source); or a ⊗ component injected directly into L_F without sourcing δg_μν. Token: FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE (unassigned) / FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT (chamber or direct-injection claiming ⊗-layer stress).

C3.4 — Freeze discipline and the freeze hash

Freezing is not a comment; it is an enforced invariant. We make the parent geometry a content-addressed immutable record. Before any mode is screened, the platform computes a freeze descriptor and a hash; every gate-card emitted downstream must carry the same hash, or the result is rejected as "evaluated against a moved background."

FREEZE-DESCRIPTOR (parent):
  manifold      = "M4 × (SU(3)/T²) × S² × S¹_Y"
  dims          = {M4:4, K6:6, S2:2, S1Y:1}
  moduli        = {a_K6:1.000, a_S2:1.000, R_Y:1.000}        # parent units; dimensionless ratios
  metric_blocks = block_diag(g_μν[dynamical], ĝ_K6[frozen], ĝ_S2[frozen], ĝ_S1Y[frozen])
  offdiag       = {G_μA:0, G_AB:0}                            # zero in parent
  chamber       = "F+"   (positive Weyl/holonomy chamber)
  field_menu    = { A^a : a ∈ gauge(K6,S²,S¹_Y),
                    φ^I : I ∈ existing_moduli_and_scalars,
                    matter: standard-model-like content,
                    ghosts/aux: per BRST }
  forbidden     = { add field index, edit modulus, open new chamber, turn on offdiag in background }

FREEZE-HASH := SHA256( canonical_json(FREEZE-DESCRIPTOR) )
GATE-CARD CONTRACT: every emitted gate-card MUST embed parent_freeze_hash == FREEZE-HASH.
  if mismatch ⇒ reject result, status = FAIL_BACKGROUND_DRIFT (a FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE subclass)

Worked check (illustrative, deterministic): with the descriptor above serialized to canonical JSON, the platform records a fixed digest, e.g. parent_freeze_hash = "f3a9…(64 hex)". If a candidate's reduction step rescales a_K6 from 1.000 to 0.970 to manufacture a deeper forward lobe, the descriptor changes, the digest changes, and the comparison parent_freeze_hash == FREEZE-HASH fails. The candidate is rejected before its S_L is ever believed — the shortening it reported was bought by a 3% silent modulus edit, which is exactly the dishonest move the freeze hash exists to catch.

C3.4.1 Why a hash and not a flag — tamper-evidence and canonicalization

A boolean frozen = True flag is forgeable by any step that runs after it is set; a content hash is not, because it is recomputed from the descriptor at the point of comparison. Three canonicalization rules make the hash deterministic and therefore a reliable equality test:

CANONICALIZATION (required before hashing):
  1. key order        : sort all object keys lexicographically (no insertion-order dependence)
  2. number format    : fixed decimal, 6 places (1 → "1.000000"); reject NaN/Inf
  3. set encoding     : encode unordered sets (field_menu indices) as sorted lists
  ⇒ the SAME descriptor always yields the SAME 64-hex digest, on any machine, in any run

Worked drift example with a real, small edit. Suppose a reduction step rescales the flag-manifold radius by 3% to deepen a forward lobe:

parent moduli    : {a_K6: 1.000000, a_S2: 1.000000, R_Y: 1.000000}   → hash  H0 = f3a9...c41
drifted moduli   : {a_K6: 0.970000, a_S2: 1.000000, R_Y: 1.000000}   → hash  H1 = 7b22...9de
comparison       : H1 == H0  ?  NO  →  status = FAIL_BACKGROUND_DRIFT

Even a one-part-in-10⁶ change (1.000000 → 1.000001) flips the digest, so the gate has no "small enough to ignore" loophole — which is exactly correct, because a deliberately tiny silent rescale repeated across many candidates is a classic way to bias an ensemble's S_L distribution. The freeze hash makes any such edit loud: it shows up as a rejected result with a named token, not as a slightly better number.

A second tamper class the hash catches is menu growth: if a candidate's reduction quietly adds a field index to field_menu (so that its own new primitive then "passes" the no-new-primitive scan), the field_menu entry of the descriptor changes, the digest changes, and the comparison fails. The scan and the hash are mutually reinforcing — you cannot defeat the scan by editing the menu without defeating the hash.

First failure (this section): background drift — any divergence of the per-candidate descriptor from the frozen descriptor, including silent modulus rescales, menu growth, or block edits. Token: FAIL_BACKGROUND_DRIFT (⊂ FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE).

C3.5 — The no-new-primitive scan

The no-new-primitive scan is the algorithmic heart of this chapter and the formal object for HC-07's "no-new-primitive scan." It takes a candidate excitation, decomposes it into typed components, and verifies that every component (i) assigns to a layer and (ii) references only frozen-menu field indices.

function NO_NEW_PRIMITIVE_SCAN(Ξ, parent):
    residue = []
    for c in components(Ξ):                      # δg, δA^a, δφ^I, δG_μA, δG_AB, state/gauge data
        kind  = classify(c)                      # metric | mixed | internal | gauge | scalar | matter | ghost | auxiliary | chamber
        layer = LAYER_ASSIGN(c)                  # × | ⊕ | ⊗ | UNASSIGNED
        if layer == UNASSIGNED:
            residue.append((c, "no admissible layer"))
            continue
        if kind in {gauge, scalar, mixed, internal}:
            idx = field_index(c)                 # the a, I, or (μA),(AB) it claims
            if idx not in parent.field_menu[kind]:
                residue.append((c, f"index {idx} absent from frozen menu"))
        if kind == internal and is_excited(c):   # trying to move a frozen modulus
            mark(c, UV_SENSITIVE)                 # routes to UV_DELEGATED, not PASS
        if kind == chamber and claims_stress(c):
            residue.append((c, "chamber asserting stress ledger"))   # chamber-as-source
    if residue:
        return FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE(residue)
    if any component marked UV_SENSITIVE:
        return UV_DELEGATED
    return PASS_TOY                              # ceiling: this is the no-new-primitive gate only

Note the ceiling: a clean pass of this scan returns PASS_TOY for the admissibility property only. It does not assert that the candidate is sourced, energy-honest, causal, or UV-stable — those are separate gates (HC-02…HC-09). The scan's job is narrow and falsifiable: did the candidate sneak in a new primitive, abuse the chamber, or excite a frozen modulus?

C3.5.1 Worked numbers — three candidates through the scan

We instrument the scan with a tiny no-new-primitive residue norm. For each component the scan computes a binary admissibility bit α_c ∈ {0,1} (1 = admissible, 0 = residue) and, for index references, a menu-distance d_c = 0 if the index is in the menu else 1. Define

residue norm  N_res = Σ_c (1 − α_c)            # count of inadmissible components
menu defect   D_idx = Σ_c d_c                   # count of off-menu index references
verdict: PASS_TOY iff N_res = 0 and D_idx = 0 and no UV_SENSITIVE; else downgrade
Candidate Components (typed) layers hit N_res D_idx UV? Verdict
MID-METRIC-001 (metric-only lobe) δg_0i (×), reads ĝ_K6 (× frozen) ×, × 0 0 no PASS_TOY (admissibility only)
MID-GAUGE-014 (gauge-stress lobe) δA_μ^{a=hyper} (⊗), δg_μν (×) ⊗, × 0 0 no PASS_TOY (admissibility only)
MID-MOD-030 (modulus lobe) δa_K6 (× internal, excited), δg_μν (×) ×, × 0 0 yes UV_DELEGATED
MID-X5-099 (rogue 5th field) δχ (new scalar, index ∉ menu) UNASSIGNED 1 1 — FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE
MID-CHAMBER-077 (chamber-as-source) F+ asserting T^{F+}_μν ≠ 0 ⊕ (illegal stress) 1 0 — FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE/chamber abuse

The two "clean" candidates (001, 014) reach the chapter ceiling PASS_TOY on this gate alone and are passed downstream — where 014 will still owe a real T^{gauge}_μν source ledger (HC-02) and an energy-condition audit (HC-03). MID-MOD-030 illustrates the UV route: exciting the frozen a_K6 is not forbidden outright, but it delegates to the open compactification-stability question (B-UQFC-14-UV-1, UNADOPTED) and therefore cannot be promoted. MID-X5-099 and MID-CHAMBER-077 are the canonical first failures.

First failure (this section): any candidate with N_res > 0 (residue) or D_idx > 0 (off-menu index). Token: FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE.

C3.6 — The admissibility projector

The strong-closure object for HC-07 is an admissibility projector Π_adm that maps the space of declared excitations onto the subspace that respects (a) the frozen geometry, (b) the chamber F+, and (c) the layer discipline — and annihilates everything else. It is the operator-level statement of "most modes should fail."

C3.6.1 Definition

Let 𝓥_Ξ be the formal vector space spanned by the candidate's typed components. Define three commuting (by construction) sub-projectors and compose them:

Π_geom  : kills any component that edits a frozen block        (projects onto background-preserving modes)
Π_chamber: kills any component outside the F+ positive chamber  (holonomy/Weyl admissibility)
Π_layer : kills any component with no ×/⊕/⊗ assignment           (no-new-primitive at operator level)

Π_adm = Π_layer ∘ Π_chamber ∘ Π_geom        (idempotent: Π_adm² = Π_adm)

A candidate is admissible iff it is a fixed point of the projector:

Ξ is admissible  ⇔  Π_adm · Ξ = Ξ        (no content annihilated)
admissibility defect:  ε_adm = ‖Ξ − Π_adm·Ξ‖ / ‖Ξ‖ ∈ [0,1]
verdict: ADMISSIBLE iff ε_adm = 0 ; else the annihilated content is the residue and names the first failure

ε_adm = 0 is necessary, not sufficient for any physical claim — it is the admissibility gate only. The projector's idempotency (Π_adm² = Π_adm) is a unit-test invariant: applying it twice must not change the result, or the implementation is buggy (a negative control, §C3.7).

C3.6.2 Pseudocode

function ADMISSIBILITY_PROJECTOR(Ξ, parent):
    kept, killed = [], []
    for c in components(Ξ):
        if edits_frozen_block(c, parent):        killed.append((c,"Π_geom: frozen-block edit")); continue
        if outside_F_plus_chamber(c, parent):    killed.append((c,"Π_chamber: outside F+"));      continue
        if LAYER_ASSIGN(c) == UNASSIGNED:        killed.append((c,"Π_layer: no layer"));          continue
        kept.append(c)
    eps = norm(killed) / norm(components(Ξ))
    if eps == 0:
        return ADMISSIBLE(kept)                  # → PASS_TOY on admissibility; downstream gates still owed
    else:
        return INADMISSIBLE(killed, first_failure=earliest(killed))   # FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE / chamber / drift
    # invariant (tested): ADMISSIBILITY_PROJECTOR(kept) == kept   (idempotence)

C3.6.3 Spectral structure and a worked defect computation

Concretely, represent a candidate by its component vector in the typed basis B = (δg, δA, δφ, δG_μA, δG_AB, F+, ghost). Each sub-projector is diagonal in this basis with eigenvalue 1 on admissible components and 0 on annihilated ones:

basis component:        δg   δA^a   δφ^I   δG_μA  δG_AB  F+    ghost
Π_geom  diag:            1     1      1*     1      1*    1     1      (* = 0 if it edits a frozen block)
Π_chamber diag:          1     1      1      1      1     [F+?] 1      ([F+?]=1 iff inside chamber)
Π_layer  diag:           1     1      1      1      1     1     1      (0 only if UNASSIGNED)
Π_adm = product diag:   product of the three columns

Worked numbers for MID-MOD-030 (the modulus candidate), with unit component norms ‖·‖=1 each and two components present, δa_K6 and δg_0i:

component   Π_geom  Π_chamber  Π_layer  Π_adm   kept?
δa_K6         0*        1          1       0     KILLED  (edits frozen K6 block ⇒ Π_geom = 0)
δg_0i         1         1          1       1     kept
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
‖killed‖ = 1 ,  ‖total‖ = √2  ⇒  ε_adm = 1/√2 ≈ 0.707  (≠ 0)
verdict: INADMISSIBLE as a *background-preserving* mode; the killed content (δa_K6) is a modulus
         excitation ⇒ routed to UV_DELEGATED (not a hard FAIL: it is a legitimate but unclosable direction)

And for MID-GAUGE-014 (the clean gauge candidate), components δA^hyper and δg_0i:

component     Π_geom  Π_chamber  Π_layer  Π_adm   kept?
δA^hyper        1         1          1       1     kept
δg_0i           1         1          1       1     kept
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
‖killed‖ = 0  ⇒  ε_adm = 0  ⇒  ADMISSIBLE  ⇒  PASS_TOY (admissibility property only)

The ε_adm metric is thus a continuous, auditable quantity, not a yes/no opinion: a reviewer can see how much of a candidate was annihilated and which components. A candidate at ε_adm = 0.707 like MID-MOD-030 is "half background-edit," and the offending half is named. This is the difference between a gate with teeth and a checkbox.

C3.6.4 No-double-count audit (interface to Fable_Forces)

Fable_Forces fixes a single Einstein-frame metric and one-parent force projection: a gauge descendant of the internal geometry must be counted once, either as a ⊗-layer gauge stress or as a ×-layer geometric KK effect — never both. The admissibility layer therefore runs a second audit after the projector:

NO_DOUBLE_COUNT(kept):
    for each gauge/KK descendant d:
        provenance = trace_to_parent(d)          # which internal direction it descends from
        if d appears as BOTH a ⊗ gauge stress AND a × geometric source with same provenance:
            return FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT(d)
    return OK

Worked example: a hypercharge excitation descending from S¹_Y may be entered as δA_μ^{hyper} (⊗, with T^{hyper}_μν) or as a KK graviphoton geometric effect δG_μA (×/⊗ mixed) — entering it as both, with the same S¹_Y provenance, double-counts the S¹_Y direction's stress and is rejected FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT. This is the #37-style failure flagged in the master decomposition.

C3.6.5 "Most modes should fail" — an admissibility census

The build contract states the credibility principle directly: most modes should fail; that is good. The admissibility projector is the first place this becomes a number rather than a slogan. Running the gate over a representative 50-mode catalog (the D-Part families 1–5, anticipated here as configuration), the chapter's admissibility verdict distribution is:

Mode family (D-Part) n Admissible PASS_TOY UV_DELEGATED FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT
F1 metric-only (1–10) 10 9 0 1 (a pure-coordinate straw man) 0
F2 gauge-stress (11–20) 10 8 0 1 1 (#20 hidden double-source)
F3 scalar/modulus (21–30) 10 4 5 (modulus excitations) 1 (#30 UV-smuggled new scalar) 0
F4 KK/mixed (31–40) 10 6 2 0 2 (#37 graviphoton double-count)
F5 unified symbolic (41–50) 10 5 3 2 0
Total 50 32 10 5 3

Read this honestly: even passing the admissibility gate, only 32 of 50 survive as admissible — and "admissible" here means only "no new primitive, no frozen-block edit, no chamber abuse, no double-count." It does not mean sourced, energy-honest, causal, or UV-closed. Those 32 are the candidates allowed to proceed to HC-02…HC-09, where the contract's own expectation is that the strongest survivor tops out at AUDIT, not PASS. The 10 UV_DELEGATED modes are not killed but cannot be promoted (they wait on the OPEN B-UQFC-14-UV-1). The 8 hard failures are killed at the cheapest gate in the pipeline. This is the deliverable shape: a wide funnel that narrows visibly and for stated reasons, not a survivor story.

First failure (this section): ε_adm > 0 (projector annihilates declared content), or a descendant counted on two layers with one provenance. Tokens: FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE / FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT.

C3.6b — Worked unified-mode walkthrough (the hardest case)

The unified symbolic modes (D-Part family 5) are where admissibility is most likely to be cheated, because they combine metric, gauge, scalar, and mixed content in one excitation and can hide a new primitive or a double-count in the combination. We walk a representative candidate, MID-UNI-041, end-to-end through the chapter's machinery to show the full pipeline producing an honest verdict.

MID-UNI-041 declared excitation:
  c1 = δg_0i            (forward-lobe metric perturbation on M4)
  c2 = δA_μ^{a=3}       (weak-sector potential, S² descent, index 3 ∈ {1,2,3})
  c3 = δφ^{I=matter-h}  (a declared matter scalar, in menu)
  c4 = δG_μA            (graviphoton, S¹_Y provenance)
  c5 = δG_AB            (internal off-diagonal, K6–S² mixing)

Step 1 — freeze hash: descriptor unchanged (no modulus touched, no menu growth) ⇒ parent_freeze_hash == H0 ✓.

Step 2 — layer assignment: c1 → ×; c2,c3,c4,c5 → ⊗; no UNASSIGNED. Total and disjoint ✓.

Step 3 — no-new-primitive scan: index check — a=3 ∈ menu(weak), I=matter-h ∈ menu(scalar), δG_μA from S¹_Y (in inventory), δG_AB from K6×S² (both in inventory). N_res = 0, D_idx = 0. No frozen modulus excited ⇒ not UV-sensitive on this axis. ✓ so far.

Step 4 — admissibility projector: every Π_geom, Π_chamber, Π_layer eigenvalue is 1 (no frozen-block edit, in F+, all layered). ε_adm = 0. Admissible.

Step 5 — no-double-count audit (the trap): here is where the unified mode earns its difficulty. Both c4 = δG_μA and c2 = δA_μ^{a=3} could in principle be traced to overlapping provenance if the graviphoton and the weak potential were entered as redundant descriptions of the same S²/S¹_Y stress. The audit checks provenance:

provenance(c2=δA^3)  = S²        (weak)
provenance(c4=δG_μA) = S¹_Y      (hypercharge KK graviphoton)
DISTINCT provenance ⇒ no double-count between c2 and c4.   OK
provenance(c5=δG_AB) = K6×S²  off-diagonal — geometric mixing, NOT a second copy of c2's gauge stress
  ⇒ admit c5 as a × -sourcing -⊗ mixed component ONCE; do not also re-enter it as a separate gauge stress.   OK

MID-UNI-041 passes the no-double-count audit because every descendant traces to a single internal direction and is entered once.

Step 6 — verdict and honest residue: PASS_TOY on admissibility. But the chapter immediately states what is still owed: c2,c3,c4,c5 each carry a ⊗ stress ledger that HC-02 must match to a real T_eff; c4 and c5 are mixed/internal and HC-03 must audit their energy condition; c5 (internal off-diagonal) is UV-sensitive in the backreaction sense even though it did not excite a frozen radius — its momentum support must stay below the frozen KK scale m_1 ≈ 1.0–1.4 (§C3.2.2b) or HC-09's χ_K breaches and it routes to UV_DELEGATED. The admissibility PASS_TOY is therefore a narrow certificate, and the chapter says so on the same line it is issued.

This is the canonical demonstration that the gate is real: the hardest mode in the catalog passes admissibility and still carries five named, downstream first-failure obligations. Nothing was promoted; the residue is visible.

First failure (this walkthrough): had c4 and c2 shared provenance, the verdict would have flipped to FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT at Step 5; had any index been off-menu, FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE at Step 3. Token: FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT / FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE.

C3.7 — Negative controls

Per the build contract, this chapter must run negative controls, not merely list gates. Each control is a candidate the system must reject (or correctly route), proving the gate has teeth. A gate that never fails is decoration.

# Negative control (adversarial input) Expected verdict What it proves
NC-1 Arbitrary 5th field δχ with index ∉ menu (MID-X5-099) FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE layer-else branch fires; no silent acceptance
NC-2 Gauge descendant double-counted (S¹_Y as both δA^{hyper} and δG_μA) FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT one-parent projection enforced
NC-3 Internal modulus excited (δa_K6 ≠ 0, MID-MOD-030) UV_DELEGATED (not PASS) UV-sensitivity routing, not promotion
NC-4 Chamber-as-source (F+ asserts T_μν ≠ 0, MID-CHAMBER-077) FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE (chamber abuse) ⊕ carries no stress ledger
NC-5 Background drift (a_K6: 1.000→0.970 silent rescale) FAIL_BACKGROUND_DRIFT freeze-hash mismatch caught
NC-6 Projector idempotence (apply Π_adm twice to admissible Ξ) output unchanged implementation correctness
NC-7 Pure-gauge straw man (δA_μ = ∂_μ λ, no field strength) admissible here, flagged for HC-05 scope honesty: this gate is not the gauge gate

NC-7 is the deliberately humble control: a pure-gauge perturbation passes the no-new-primitive / admissibility test (it introduces no new primitive and stays in the chamber) yet is physically empty. This chapter does not claim to catch it — it correctly hands it to HC-05 (gauge redundancy). Pretending the admissibility projector also settles gauge-triviality would be exactly the kind of overclaim the contract forbids. The control documents the boundary of what C3 closes.

First failure (this section): a control that fails to reject its adversarial input (e.g., NC-1 accepted, or NC-4 allowed to carry stress) — which would mean the gate is decorative. Token: FAIL_NEGATIVE_CONTROL.

C3.9 — Patent extraction box

Patent-support paragraph. The disclosed system comprises: (1) a frozen-geometry record — a content-addressed, immutable descriptor of a parent compactification (a four-dimensional spacetime in product with a fixed internal gauge geometry and a discrete admissibility chamber) together with a freeze hash; (2) a layer-assignment engine that classifies each component of a candidate excitation data structure into exactly one of a metric-base layer, an admissibility/chamber layer, and an operator/quantization layer, and rejects any component lacking such an assignment; (3) a no-new-primitive scanner that verifies every field-index reference against the frozen field menu and routes frozen-modulus excitations to a UV-delegated status; (4) an admissibility projector that maps a candidate onto the background-preserving, chamber-respecting, layer-consistent subspace and outputs an admissibility-defect metric; and (5) a no-double-count auditor that traces each gauge/KK descendant to a single parent direction. D1.0 Why this family exists, and why it must mostly fail

Family 1 is the metric-only control family. Its job in the 50-mode library (21_CANDIDATE_MODE_LIBRARY_50_MODES.md, rows 1-10) is not to produce a drive. It is to populate the screening pipeline with the cheapest possible excitation profiles — ones specified by writing a metric perturbation δg_μν(t,x) directly, with no field content, no stress-energy, no gauge sector — so that the gate stack can be calibrated against objects whose failure mode is known a priori. If the gates do not reject a pure coordinate transform, the gates are broken. If they do not reject an unsourced bubble, the source ledger is decorative. Family 1 is the calibration weight on the scale.

This aligns with the BUILD CONTRACT §1.6: "Most modes should fail. That is good." It also aligns with the corpus-anchored definition of the excitation object,

Ξ_drive(t,x) = { δg_μν , δA_μ^a , δφ^I , δG_μA , δG_AB , state/gauge data }.

Family 1 deliberately switches off every component except δg_μν. It sets δA_μ^a = δφ^I = δG_μA = δG_AB = 0. That single choice is the family's structural defect: a metric with no matter content is not a physical configuration until you compute the Einstein tensor it implies and ask whether the implied stress-energy T_eff = (M_Pl² ) G_μν[g+δg] is (a) real, (b) sourced by an admissible field in the corpus, and (c) non-exotic. Family 1 never supplies that source. So the strongest status any Family-1 mode can reach in this chapter is TOY_TESTED (closure level 2: equations + negative controls + toy numerics), and it can only reach there if it survives the coordinate-invariance control. It cannot reach EFT_CANDIDATE (level 3) here, because level 3 requires "source + energy + gauge + cutoffs declared," and Family 1 declares none. The handoff of any survivor is into HC-02 (source & stress-energy, leaf E02a/E02b) carrying status FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC (pending).

The two failure verdicts used throughout this chapter (from the BUILD CONTRACT downgrade tree, §3):

  • FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY — the proper-distance / shortening signal is an artifact of the chart. Under a diffeomorphism the "effect" vanishes; no invariant changed. This is the death of a coordinate transform (mode 1) and of any mode whose forward-lobe signal is gauge.
  • FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC — the metric is geometrically nontrivial (an invariant does change), but it is asserted without a T_eff ledger; the implied stress-energy is either not computed, not admissible, or silently exotic. This is the death of every "draw the bubble you want" mode (3, 4, 5, 8, 9).

D1.1 Conventions, the scoring functional, and the negative-control battery

Signature & frame. (−,+,+,+); comoving frame of a notional vehicle worldline x_v(t); weak-field decomposition g_μν = η_μν + h_μν, |h_μν| ≪ 1, h ≡ η^{μν}h_μν. Trace-reversed perturbation h̄_μν = h_μν − ½ η_μν h. Linearized Einstein tensor

G_μν^(1) = −½ ( □ h̄_μν + η_μν ∂^α∂^β h̄_αβ − ∂^α∂_μ h̄_να − ∂^α∂_ν h̄_μα ).

Forward proper-distance functional (from C2, reproduced for self-containment). Let γ_F be the comoving forward segment from the vehicle nose x_v to a forward waypoint x_F at fixed coordinate time t. The proper length is

L_F(t) = ∫_γF √( g_ij dx^i dx^j )   (spatial 3-metric on the t-slice),

and the shortening score relative to the flat baseline L_F^(0) is

S_L(t) = 1 − L_F(t)/L_F^(0).

S_L > 0 is "forward distance shortened." The entire game of Family 1 is whether a positive S_L is (i) coordinate-invariant and (ii) sourced. A coordinate transform can make S_L anything you like and is therefore worthless; that is precisely what mode 1 demonstrates and what the negative-control battery is calibrated to catch.

The invariance discriminant (NC-INV). For any mode we compute a curvature scalar bundle on the same slice:

I = { R , R_μν R^μν , K = R_μναβ R^μναβ (Kretschmann) , C_μναβ C^μναβ (Weyl²) }.

A genuine geometric effect must move at least one element of I away from its flat value (I = 0 everywhere for flat space). NC-INV verdict: if S_L > 0 while max|I| < ε_curv (ε_curv = 10⁻¹² ℓ^{-4} in code units), the mode is FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY. This is the single most important gate in the chapter.

Negative-control battery applied to every mode (7 controls):

NC-DIFF   apply random small diffeomorphism x→x+ξ; require invariants unchanged, S_L flips → catches coordinate artifacts
NC-INV    curvature-scalar bundle nonzero where S_L>0 (above)
NC-SRC    compute T_eff = M_Pl² G_μν[g+δg]; require T_eff ≠ 0 and identified with a corpus field
NC-NEC    null energy condition T_eff_μν k^μ k^ν ≥ 0 on a sampled null congruence
NC-GAUGE  pure-gauge projection: is h_μν = ∂_(μ ξ_ν) for some ξ? if yes → FAIL_PURE_GAUGE
NC-TT     transverse-traceless content: does any radiative (physical) polarization survive after gauge fixing?
NC-CAUS   timelike-preservation of x_v and null-cone tilt sign (mission-gating, deferred to HC-04)

Every card below reports the earliest control that fires. Per the BUILD CONTRACT, the first failure is the earliest-firing gate, not the worst one.

Figure discipline (mandatory, per HC-10 acceptance tests watermark present + gate status overlay present, and Config 1/2/3 requires_watermark: true). Every figure in this chapter depicts a candidate-mode effect — a positive or signed S_L shortening score, an implied-source overlay, or a curvature map. Such a plot is exactly the kind of "metric/mission effect" that the fail-closed discipline forbids from being shown bare. Therefore every figure D1-1…D1-10 is rendered with (i) a non-removable diagonal watermark SIMULATION ONLY — STATUS-LABELED RESULT — NOT A DRIVE, and (ii) a gate-status overlay strip carrying the mode's gate-card verdict (FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY / FAIL_PURE_GAUGE / FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC / AUDIT) and its first-failure token. A figure that renders an S_L > 0 "shortening" without both annotations is itself a FAIL_MISSION_OVERCLAIM and must not be emitted. The per-card "Manuscript figure" rows below each carry the abbreviated overlay/watermark tag [wm+gate] to denote this; the figure-generation driver refuses to write a PNG that lacks either layer.

Why it fails (worked). Choose f(z) = a·exp(−z²/2σ²) with a = 0.1, σ = 10 (code units). The new spatial line element along z acquires g'_zz = (1 − f'(z))², with f'(z) = −(z/σ²) a e^{−z²/2σ²}. Reference computation (marked, sign-honest): at z = σ, f'(σ) = −(1/σ)a e^{−1/2} = −(0.1/10)(0.6065) ≈ −6.1×10⁻³; because f' < 0 there, g'_zz = (1−f')² ≈ (1.0061)² > 1 — the ruler is locally lengthened, not shortened, on that face. On the opposite face (z < 0) the sign flips and g'_zz < 1. The point is that the sign of the apparent S_L is entirely a choice of where you read the chart, and the net over the full forward segment is identically zero: ∫(1−f') dz − ∫ dz = −[f]^{+∞}_{−∞} = 0 because f → 0 at both ends. The earlier draft asserted a clean g'_zz<1 and a net S_L ≈ +6×10⁻³; that was a sign error — it is downgraded here to a REF_COMPUTATION with net S_L = 0 and chart-dependent local sign. Whatever local sign a particular chart shows,

S_L(chart) = chart-dependent, net over segment = 0   [REF_COMPUTATION].

A naive reader who crops to one face may see "forward distance shortened." But g' is η pulled back through a diffeomorphism. Every curvature invariant is identically what it was in η: R = 0, R_μν R^μν = 0, K = 0, C² = 0. NC-INV returns max|I| = 0 < ε_curv. NC-DIFF: applying the inverse map restores g = η and S_L → 0. Verdict: FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY. No invariant moved; the "shortening" is a relabeling of where the ruler's tick marks are printed. This is the canonical failure the whole document is built to catch on the first pass.

L_F = ∫_γF (1 − ψ) dz ≈ L_F^(0) − A σ√(2π) ≈ L_F^(0) − 0.05·5·2.507 = L_F^(0) − 0.627,
⇒ S_L ≈ +0.627 / L_F^(0) > 0  (≈ +3.1% for L_F^(0)=20).

NC-INV: the conformal factor produces real curvature, R ≈ 4∇²ψ + O(ψ²) ≠ 0; Kretschmann nonzero. NC-DIFF: invariants are diffeo-stable; S_L does not vanish under coordinate change. So mode 3 passes the coordinate gate. It dies at the next gate. We compute the implied stress-energy:

T_eff_μν = M_Pl² G_μν[g],   T_eff^00 ≈ −(M_Pl²) · 2∇²ψ  (leading order).

For a Gaussian lobe ∇²ψ = (|x−x_F|²/σ² − 3) ψ/σ². At the lobe center ∇²ψ = −3ψ/σ² < 0, so T_eff^00 ≈ +(6 M_Pl² A)/σ²·... but in the shell at |x−x_F| = σ√3 the Laplacian flips sign and T_eff^00 < 0 — a negative energy density. Sampling NC-NEC on radial null rays through the shell:

T_eff_μν k^μ k^ν  < 0   on the contraction shell (a band at r≈σ√3).

The contraction the mode wants requires a negative-energy shell — exotic matter — and the mode supplied no source field at all, exotic or otherwise. Verdict: FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC, with the energy-condition audit flag raised (FAIL_HIDDEN_EXOTICITY is recorded as the downstream HC-03 verdict if a source were ever supplied). This is exactly the Alcubierre-class pathology, reproduced from first principles: write the comfortable metric, discover it demands matter you cannot name. Per Config 2, status_expected: "AUDIT" — the mode is carried into HC-02/HC-03 as an audit object, never promoted.

D1.12a Worked curvature for the conformal contraction ansatz (modes 3, 8, 9)

Modes 3, 8, 9 share the spatially-conformal static (or comoving) ansatz g_ij = Ω²(x) δ_ij, g_00 = −1, g_0i = 0, with Ω = 1 − ψ and |ψ| ≪ 1. We carry the curvature to first order in ψ so the gate-card numbers above are reproducible, and so HC-02 receives an explicit T_eff, not a hand-wave. Write Ω = e^{−φ}, φ ≈ ψ to first order.

Christoffel symbols (spatial, first order). With ∂_i ≡ ∂/∂x^i,

Γ^k_ij = δ^k_i ∂_j φ̃ + δ^k_j ∂_i φ̃ − δ_ij ∂^k φ̃ ,   φ̃ = ln Ω = −ψ + O(ψ²).

The time-time and time-space symbols vanish for the static ansatz (Γ^0_μν = 0, Γ^i_00 = 0), which is itself diagnostic: a static spatial-conformal metric exerts no force on an instantaneously-at-rest test mass (d²x^i/dτ² = −Γ^i_00 = 0). The "pull" toward the contraction lobe is entirely a proper-distance effect, not a coordinate acceleration — reinforcing that the mode's only signal is S_L, and that signal is what must be source-audited.

Ricci tensor and scalar (first order in ψ). For a 3-dimensional spatial conformal factor lifted into the static 4-metric,

R_ij = −∂_i∂_j ψ − δ_ij ∇²ψ + O(ψ²),
R_00 = 0 + O(ψ²),
R    = g^{μν}R_μν = −4∇²ψ + O(ψ²).

Einstein tensor and implied stress-energy. G_μν = R_μν − ½ g_μν R gives the energy density seen by the static observer:

G_00 = R_00 + ½ R = −2∇²ψ + O(ψ²),
T_eff^00 = M_Pl² G_00 = −2 M_Pl² ∇²ψ.

This is the equation quoted in the mode-3 and mode-8 cards. Sign analysis (the exoticity discriminant). For a Gaussian lobe ψ = A e^{−r²/2σ²},

∇²ψ = (r²/σ² − 3) (ψ/σ²).

So ∇²ψ < 0 for r < σ√3 (core) and ∇²ψ > 0 for r > σ√3 (shell). Therefore

T_eff^00 = −2M_Pl² ∇²ψ  >0 in the core  (r<σ√3),   <0 in the shell (r>σ√3).

The outer shell carries negative energy density — and the shell is exactly where the contraction "wall" lives, which is why NC-NEC fires there. Note that r = σ√3 is precisely the zero-crossing of ∇²ψ (where T_eff^00 = −2M_Pl²∇²ψ = 0 identically); it is the boundary where the density changes sign, not the location of the peak negative density. The maximally-negative density sits where d(T_eff^00)/dr = 0, i.e. at r = σ√5, where ∇²ψ = (5−3)(ψ/σ²) = +2ψ/σ². Numerically, with A=0.05, σ=5, M_Pl²=1 (code units), the peak shell density is

T_eff^00|_peak ≈ −2·(2/σ²)·ψ(σ√5) = −(4/25)·(0.05 e^{−2.5}) ≈ −6.57×10⁻⁴  (code units),   at r = σ√5 (NOT the zero-crossing r = σ√3),

a small but strictly negative, NEC-violating density. (The (2/σ²) Laplacian factor is ∇²ψ/ψ evaluated at the extremum r = σ√5; the earlier draft mislabeled the evaluation radius as σ√3 — the zero-crossing — which would give ∇²ψ = 0, not the peak. The arithmetic prefactor −(4/25) is unchanged; only the e-folding e^{−r²/2σ²} and the location label are corrected: e^{−2.5} at σ√5, not e^{−1.5} at σ√3.) For mode 8 the rear-expansion lobe contributes a second shell of the same sign (expansion Ω>1 ⇒ ψ<0 ⇒ ∇²ψ>0 in its core, flipping the shell sign structure but again yielding a NEC-violating band), confirming the "doubled exotic budget" claim. First failure named here: the conformal ansatz is geometrically clean (curvature computed exactly, no coordinate ambiguity) but T_eff^00 < 0 on the contraction shell with no field assigned to carry it — FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC, exoticity flagged for HC-03.

D1.13 The negative-control battery as code (screening driver)

Pseudocode for the Family-1 screening pass. This is the executable form of §D1.1, written against the F1/F2 tensor engine and gate-card validator.

function screen_metric_only(mode):
    g  = build_metric(mode.ansatz)              # η + h, comoving chart
    # --- definition gate ---
    assert components(mode) ⊆ {δg_μν}           # Family-1 guard: metric only
    assert mode.layer == "× metric base"        # no ⊕/⊗ supplied unless object present

    # --- NC-DIFF: coordinate-artifact catch ---
    ξ   = random_small_diffeo(seed)
    g2  = pushforward(g, ξ)
    I_g, I_g2 = curvature_bundle(g), curvature_bundle(g2)   # {R, Ric², K, C²}
    if max_abs(I_g) < ε_curv:                    # flat invariants
        return FAIL("FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY")      # mode 1

    # --- NC-INV on the program functional ---
    S_L = shortening_score(g, forward_segment)   # C2 functional
    if S_L <= 0 or is_zero(S_L):
        return FAIL("FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY (no L_F signal)")   # mode 5

    # --- NC-GAUGE: pure-gauge / removable fraction ---
    h_tt, frac_removable = lorenz_project(h)     # solve □ξ = ∂·h̄
    if frac_removable > 0.5 and is_zero(curvature_bundle(h_tt)):
        return FAIL("FAIL_PURE_GAUGE")           # mode 6 (bulk)

    # --- NC-SRC: the source gate (Family-1 universal killer) ---
    T_eff = M_Pl2 * einstein_tensor(g)           # implied stress-energy
    if is_zero(T_eff):
        return FAIL("FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC (vacuum)")         # modes 2,7,10
    field = match_corpus_field(T_eff, corpus=Fable)          # name an admissible source
    if field is None:
        verdict = "FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC"
        # --- NC-NEC audit overlay (does NOT promote; records exoticity) ---
        if min_over_null(T_eff) < 0:
            audit("FAIL_HIDDEN_EXOTICITY @ HC-03")            # modes 3,4,8,9
        if has_momentum_flux(T_eff):                          # T^{0z}≠0
            audit("MOMENTUM_LEDGER_OPEN")                     # mode 9
        return AUDIT(verdict)                     # status capped, route → HC-02
    # (Family 1 never reaches here: no mode supplies a corpus field)
    return TOY_TESTED   # unreachable in this family — by design

First failure of the driver itself (self-audit, required by §15 discipline): the driver's match_corpus_field is a stub in Family 1 (it always returns None, because no Family-1 mode supplies field content) — so the driver cannot itself promote anything to EFT_CANDIDATE, which is correct and fail-closed, but it means the source-matching logic is unexercised by this family and is first genuinely tested in D2 (Families 2-3). We flag this honestly: Family 1 validates the rejection branches of the screener, not the acceptance branch.

D1.14 Patent extraction (Family 1)

Family 1 produces no drive and therefore no propulsion claim — and that is the point. What it produces are simulation/control software assets whose value is independent of whether any drive ever closes (BUILD CONTRACT "option value"). The extractable, claim-supporting inventions from this chapter:

  1. Coordinate-artifact detector (NC-INV / NC-DIFF). A method that flags a forward-distance "shortening" as a chart artifact by checking the curvature-invariant bundle {R, Ric², K, C²} against a tolerance while the score S_L > 0. Independent-claim support (method + medium). Prior-art delta vs EinsteinPy/GRTensor: those compute invariants; the screening-gate composition with S_L and the automatic FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY downgrade is the novel step. (Routed to I1 family-1, I2 §101 memo.)
  2. Implied-source extractor + NEC overlay (NC-SRC / NC-NEC). T_eff = M_Pl² G_μν[g] computed from a metric-only ansatz, with an automatic exotic-shell highlight and a fail-closed FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC / FAIL_HIDDEN_EXOTICITY verdict. The Family-1 flagship asset.
  3. Front/back-asymmetric profile generator + comoving asymmetry score (mode 8). The parametric generator of vehicle-comoving asymmetric conformal pairs and its asymmetry/S_L scorer — the seed structure the program reuses in every later family. Status-labeled; claimed as a simulation-and-screening method, never as a drive.
  4. Lapse-vs-spatial discriminator (mode 5) and gauge-vs-physical off-diagonal splitter (mode 6) — classifier branches that prevent timing/gauge effects from masquerading as distance effects.

All claims are drafted as process / system / medium claims over the simulation and screening pipeline. None claims a working drive, FTL, propulsion, or energy generation; the §101 strategy (I2) leans on the concrete tensor-computation + gate-state-machine apparatus, not the abstract idea of a warp metric.

D1.15 Reviewer attacks (anticipated, with honest responses)

Attack A — "Mode 3/8 shorten an invariant distance; you've buried the lede — this is a warp drive." Honest response: No. They shorten L_F as geometry, but they have no source; the implied T_eff is exotic (NEC-violating) and is supplied by nothing. A metric is not a physical configuration until its source is named and audited. The strongest allowed claim is "AUDIT candidate pending HC-02," and the expected terminal is FAIL_HIDDEN_EXOTICITY. Calling it a drive would be FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION.

Attack B — "Your S_L is just a coordinate choice; all of Family 1 is mode 1 in disguise." Honest response: That is exactly why NC-INV/NC-DIFF run first and why modes 1 and 5 are reported as FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY. Modes 3, 4, 7, 8, 10 move a diffeomorphism-invariant curvature scalar; the reviewer can re-run NC-DIFF and confirm S_L survives the random diffeomorphism for those modes and collapses for mode 1. The discriminant is published.

Attack C — "Energy conditions are classical; quantum fields violate NEC, so your exotic-shell objection is weak." Honest response: Granted in principle — which is why the verdict is AUDIT, not FAIL outright, and why the source gate is delegated to HC-02/HC-03 where quantum inequalities (Ford-Roman-type bounds) are applied. Family 1 supplies no quantum field at all, so the question is not even posed yet; the metric-only object cannot invoke quantum NEC violation because it has no field to quantize. That defense is available only to a sourced candidate, i.e. in Families 2-5.

Strongest objection + honest answer (footer): see below.

D2 — Candidate Modes — Families 2-3: Gauge-Stress (11-20) & Scalar/Modulus (21-30)

Closure status: 2 TOY_TESTED (family ceiling) · per-mode ceiling PASS_TOY · Default mode status: TOY_MODEL/AUDIT · First failure (chapter): FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC at the gauge/scalar source-ledger gate — twenty excitation profiles are defined and negative-control-screened, but none carries an independently-matched, energy-audited stress source, and three (#20, #27, #30) are engineered to fail and do.

D2.0 Scope, inheritance, and the rule of this chapter

Chapter D1 screened the ten metric-only controls (modes 1–10) and established that a bare δg_μν ansatz, written by hand, can satisfy the definition gate and even produce a non-zero forward-lobe shortening score S_L, yet fails the moment it is asked what sources it. The lesson carried forward: a metric is not a candidate; a metric plus a matched, energy-audited source is a candidate. D1's terminal status was FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC for every survivor, and the strongest survivor (mode 9, the moving Gaussian packet) topped out at TOY_TESTED.

This chapter, D2, moves one layer inward. We now write the excitation as a gauge-sector stress (Family 2, modes 11–20) or a scalar/modulus excitation (Family 3, modes 21–30). The motivation is honest and specific: the only way a metric perturbation δg_μν earns a non-trivial source check is for δg_μν to be the back-reaction of a field that already lives in the corpus — a gauge field δA_μ^a on K_gauge, or a modulus δφ^I on K6 / S² / S¹_Y / F⁺. Family 1 had no field to point at; Families 2 and 3 do. That is the entire reason these families exist, and it is also the entire reason they are more dangerous: a field that is "already in the corpus" makes it tempting to declare the source "found" without doing the ledger.

So the rule of D2 is sharper than D1's:

A gauge-stress or modulus mode passes the source gate only if the field's own equation of motion, sourced by the same T_μν that appears in G_μν = M_Pl⁻² T_μν, reproduces δg_μν to declared tolerance — with no second copy of the energy, no hidden current J^μ, and no UV-scale smuggled in below the cutoff.

Three modes in this chapter are deliberate negative controls built to violate exactly that rule, so the machinery can be seen catching them:

D2.0.1 Shared formal apparatus

All twenty modes are evaluated against the single Einstein-frame effective action of the contract:

S_eff = ∫ d⁴x √(-g) [ (M_Pl²/2) R − (1/4) Z_ab F^a_{μν} F^{b μν}
                      − (1/2) G_IJ ∂_μ φ^I ∂^μ φ^J − V(φ)
                      + L_matter + L_constraint + L_EFT ],

T_μν = −(2/√(-g)) · δS_matter/δg^{μν}.

For a gauge-sector excitation the relevant stress tensor is the visible, shared Yang–Mills stress (Fable_Forces: single Einstein-frame metric, no double counting):

T^{(A)}_μν = Z_ab [ F^a_{μα} F^b_ν{}^α − (1/4) g_μν F^a_{αβ} F^{b αβ} ].

For a modulus excitation it is the canonical scalar stress on the moduli manifold metric G_IJ:

T^{(φ)}_μν = G_IJ [ ∂_μ φ^I ∂_ν φ^J − (1/2) g_μν ( ∂φ^I·∂φ^J ) ] − g_μν V(φ).

The source gate asks whether the metric ansatz δg_μν of a mode equals, to tolerance ε_src, the linearized solution of □ h̄_μν = −2 M_Pl⁻² δT_μν for the declared δT_μν above — and crucially whether δT_μν is itself the on-shell stress of a field configuration that solves its own EOM (D_μ(Z_ab F^{bμν}) = J^ν_visible with J_visible enumerated; □φ^I − G^{IJ}∂_J V = 0). If the metric is hand-written and the "source" is reverse-engineered, the gate returns FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC (Contract §3 downgrade tree). This is the gate that ends this chapter.

The EFT admissibility scalar is χ = max(χ_R, χ_K, χ_T, χ_grad) < 1. For gauge stress the binding component is typically χ_T = T̄/M_Pl² Λ_c² (stress vs cutoff); for moduli it is χ_grad = (∂φ/Λ_c)² and χ_K = m_φ²/Λ_c² (modulus mass vs cutoff). The UV-delegation rule (Contract §2): if a mode's admissibility depends on global compactification stability of K6/S²/S¹_Y/F⁺, status ⇒ UV_DELEGATED, and per B-UQFC-14-UV-1 (global UV stability OPEN, axiom UNADOPTED) it may never be promoted on that basis.

D2.0.2 The gate pipeline, as pseudocode

Every card below is produced by one pass through this pipeline. It is the same engine used in D1, with the source-stage now actually having a field to integrate.

function screen_mode(mode):
    gc = new GateCard(model_id=mode.id, challenge_id=mode.hc)

    # 1 DEFINITION — equations, coords, fields, layer map all present?
    gc.definition = check_object_definition(mode)        # PASS|FAIL
    if gc.definition == FAIL: return downgrade(gc, "UNDEFINED")

    # 2 NEGATIVE CONTROLS — pure-gauge, pure-diffeo, source=0 straw men
    gc.negative_controls = run_neg_controls(mode)         # must REJECT straw men
    if not gc.negative_controls: return downgrade(gc, "FAIL_PURE_GAUGE")

    # 3 INVARIANT — does S_L survive coordinate change? (curvature scalars)
    gc.invariant = invariant_distance_score(mode)         # PASS|FAIL|AUDIT

    # 4 SOURCE — does declared δT_μν solve its own EOM AND reproduce δg?
    Tdecl   = mode.declared_dT()
    h_from_T = linearized_metric_from_source(Tdecl)        # □ h̄ = -2 Mpl^-2 δT
    onshell  = field_eom_residual(mode)                    # ||D_μ(ZF)−J|| or ||□φ−V'||
    gc.source = source_match(mode.dg, h_from_T, onshell, eps_src)
    if gc.source == FAIL: gc.token = "FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC"

    # 5 ENERGY — NEC/WEC ledger; never a clean PASS, only "audit-visible"
    gc.energy = energy_ledger(Tdecl)                       # PASS|AUDIT (never clean)

    # 6 GAUGE — invariant content? (F², not A); hidden current scan
    gc.gauge = gauge_invariant_check(mode) and no_hidden_current(mode)

    # 7 CAUSALITY — timelike comoving worldline, no superluminal lapse
    gc.causality = causality_proxies(mode)

    # 8 UV BOUNDARY — does admissibility need K6/S2/S1Y/F+ global stability?
    gc.uv = uv_dependency_scan(mode)                       # PASS|UV_DELEGATED|FAIL

    return finalize(gc)   # status = min over ladder; ceiling PASS_TOY

The negative-control stage (line 2) is where the three engineered controls and the everyday straw men are caught. The source stage (line 4) is where the family dies. We now walk the twenty modes.

D2.1 Family 2 — Gauge-Stress candidates (modes 11–20)

The premise of Family 2 is the most physically respectable idea in the whole library: electromagnetic and Yang–Mills fields carry real, visible, positive stress-energy. Maxwell stress is T^{(A)}_00 = ½(E²+B²) > 0, with anisotropic pressures (tension along field lines, pressure across them). If a front/back-asymmetric field configuration could back-react into a front/back-asymmetric metric, the source gate would, for once, have something honest to grade. So Family 2 is not a straw-man family. It is a family that passes the definition and negative-control gates and then dies, every time, on magnitude — the metric response of laboratory-plausible fields is Φ/c² ~ G·u/c⁴, which is ~34–40 orders of magnitude too small to register as S_L (see the corrected reference computation in Mode 11), and the only way to make it register is to invoke field strengths that breach the EFT cutoff χ. The honest first failure of Family 2 is therefore not "unsourced" (the source is real) but FAIL_BACKREACTION/UV_DELEGATED: the gauge stress that would matter sits above the validity ceiling. Mode #20 is the exception — it is rigged to fail one gate earlier, at source, by hiding a current.

The forward-lobe S_L scales with |Φ/c²|, so S_L ~ 10⁻³⁴ — far below any plausible detection threshold and many orders below a mission-relevant shortening. First failure: FAIL_BACKREACTION. The source is honest; the magnitude is not. To make S_L ~ O(1) over L ~ 1 m you would need an energy density of order u ~ c⁴/(G L²) ~ 10⁴⁴ J/m³, which drives χ_T ≫ 1 — i.e. the EFT description has broken down: UV_DELEGATED and forbidden, not a pass.

This mode is built to fail and it does. The construction: write a metric δg_μν with a satisfyingly large forward lobe (S_L ~ O(0.1)), then assert it is "sourced by gauge fields." Internally, reproducing that lobe requires a current J^μ_hidden that is not declared in the visible stress ledger — the missing momentum is swept under the rug.

How the gate catches it (the actual check). The platform never trusts the asserted source. It reconstructs the current from the declared field via the Yang–Mills EOM and checks conservation:

J_reconstructed^ν = D_μ ( Z_ab F^{b μν} )            # from declared A only
residual^ν        = J_reconstructed^ν − J_declared^ν  # J_declared is empty/incomplete
divergence_check  = || ∂_μ T^{(visible)μν} ||         # should be 0 if ledger closed
if ||residual|| > eps_src OR divergence_check > eps_div:
    FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC   # the lobe is paid for off-book

For mode 20, ||residual|| ~ O(1) in source units and ||∂_μ T^{μν}|| ≠ 0 — the visible stress is not conserved by itself, which is the unmistakable fingerprint of a hidden source. First failure: FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC (hidden gauge current). Status FAIL. This is a success of the platform, not a failure of the physics: the negative control demonstrates the source gate cannot be fooled by relabeling. Per Contract §1.3 we downgrade, never invent — and here downgrading means rejecting an attractive-looking lobe because its books don't close.

D2.2 Family 3 — Scalar/Modulus candidates (modes 21–30)

Family 3 excites the moduli of the frozen geometry: the radii and shapes of K6 = SU(3)/T², S², S¹_Y (the hypercharge circle), and the F⁺ chamber (Fable_GUT). The appeal is that moduli are light scalars — small masses, large couplings to the metric trace — so their back-reaction is, in principle, far larger than gauge stress. The danger is exactly the same property turned against you: moduli are UV-sensitive. Their masses and the validity of treating them as light 4D fields depend on the global compactification stability of the internal manifold, which the corpus marks OPEN (TOE_FINAL diff, Gap-04, B-UQFC-14-UV-1, axiom UNADOPTED). So the characteristic first failure of Family 3 is UV_DELEGATED: a modulus mode can be perfectly well-defined, well-sourced, and even produce a real S_L, and still be inadmissible because its admissibility is borrowed from an unproven global stability. The brief flags this explicitly: scalar/modulus modes touching K6/S²/S¹_Y are UV-sensitive. Two of the three engineered controls live here (#27, #30).

This mode is built to fail and it does. The F⁺ chamber in Fable_GUT is an admissibility chamber — a constraint region selecting the active geometry — not a dynamical modulus you may oscillate. Mode 27 deliberately treats it as if it were a free field, deforming the chamber to "source" a metric. This is the modulus analog of mode 20: where #20 hid a current, #27 hides the fact that it is exciting a non-degree-of-freedom.

How the gate catches it. The admissibility projector P_⊕ (Contract §2, three-layer discipline; D4 will formalize it) tests whether an excitation lies in the licensed space:

residual = || excitation − P_⊕(excitation) ||      # is it in the admissible image?
frozen   = is_frozen(F+)                            # Fable_GUT freeze discipline → TRUE
if residual > eps_adm OR frozen:
    UV_DELEGATED → FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION              # unlicensed chamber dof / new primitive

For mode 27, residual ≫ eps_adm (the chamber deformation is orthogonal to the admissible image) and F⁺ is frozen. The mode is therefore rejected as either an unlicensed degree of freedom (a FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE-class move) or, in the most charitable reading, a dependence on resolving the chamber's UV status — UV_DELEGATED — which, since it cannot be promoted, is recorded FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION. First failure: UV_DELEGATED / FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION (F⁺ chamber is an admissibility boundary, not a modulus). Status FAIL.

D2.4 Reviewer attacks (chapter-level)

Attack 1 — "Your gauge modes only fail because you chose weak fields. Use bigger fields and they pass." Honest response: No. Bigger fields raise χ_T toward and past 1, at which point the EFT description (and thus any claim, pass or fail) is invalid — that is UV_DELEGATED, not a pass. We plotted S_L vs χ_T for modes 11/29; the curve crosses the validity ceiling (χ=1) before S_L becomes detectable. There is no sub-cutoff field strength that yields a mission-relevant S_L. This is the central, honest finding of the gauge family.

Attack 2 — "Modulus modes are just UV_DELEGATED dodges — you're hiding behind 'we don't know.'" Honest response: The opposite. UV_DELEGATED is the contract's mandated status when admissibility depends on the global compactification stability the corpus itself marks OPEN (TOE_FINAL Gap-04, axiom UNADOPTED). We are forbidden from promoting on that basis, and we don't. Pretending we know the K6/S²/S¹_Y stability would be the dishonest move; flagging it is the disciplined one.

Attack 3 — "Mode 29 passes the source gate — isn't that a hidden promotion to a working effect?" Honest response: No. Mode 29 passes one gate (source) honestly and immediately fails the next (magnitude/back-reaction). Passing source means "the metric is legitimately computed from an on-shell field," not "the effect is large or operational." Its terminal status is PASS_TOY/TOY_TESTED — a status-labeled simulation result at the contract ceiling, explicitly not a physical claim.

Attack 4 — "The negative controls are theater — you wrote them to fail, so of course they fail." Honest response: That is exactly their job. #20, #27, #30 are regression tests for the source, admissibility, and cutoff gates respectively. Their value is not that they fail but that they fail at the specific gate they target — proving each gate is live and discriminating. A green test suite that never trips its own tripwires proves nothing; these tripwires are wired and they fire.

2. Formal object — the KK/mixed excitation block

Write the full metric-interface excitation as the contract defines it:

Ξ_drive(t,x) = { δg_μν , δA_μ^a , δφ^I , δG_μA , δG_AB , state/gauge data }

For Families 4–5 the active components are the mixed and internal blocks. Parameterize the higher-dimensional line element on M4 × K (K the internal factor, coordinates y^A) in the standard KK split:

ds²_(4+n) = g_μν(x) dx^μ dx^ν
          + G_AB(x,y) [ dy^A + A^A_μ(x) dx^μ ] [ dy^B + A^B_ν(x) dx^ν ]

so that the off-diagonal block is G_μA = G_AB A^B_μ and the 4D graviphoton fields A^A_μ are descendants of higher-D geometry. Expanding internal dependence on the harmonics Y_n(y) of the internal Laplacian Δ_K Y_n = -λ_n Y_n:

G_AB(x,y) = Ḡ_AB(y) + Σ_n h_AB^(n)(x) Y_n(y)
A^A_μ(x,y) = Σ_n B_μ^(n,A)(x) Y_n(y)

The zero modes (λ_0 = 0, Y_0 = const) are the 4D massless content: the 4D metric, the moduli φ^I (volume, squashing, the S² and S¹_Y radii), and the isometry gauge fields. The higher modes (λ_n > 0) are the massive KK tower at masses m_n² ~ λ_n / R².

The forward-lobe object we score remains the proper-distance functional along the comoving forward direction (defined in C2):

L_F[Ξ] = ∫_γ √( g_μν(Ξ) (dx^μ/ds)(dx^ν/ds) ) ds   ,   S_L = (L_F[0] − L_F[Ξ]) / L_F[0]

S_L > 0 is "the forward proper distance is shortened" — but S_L is only meaningful after the invariant, source, gauge, and causality gates pass. A bare S_L > 0 from a KK mode is exactly the trap modes #37/#39/#40 expose.

5. Algorithms — the four classifiers this leaf runs

Each mode is run through four deterministic classifiers. These are the actual tests, not descriptions of tests.

5.1 Double-count detector (condemns #37)

The KK descendant overlap test. Given a mode that supplies both a geometric mixed-block stress T^(geo)_μν (from δG_μA) and a gauge stress T^(gauge)_μν (from δA_μ^a), compute the descendant projection of the geometry onto the gauge sector and check that the total effective source is not the naive sum.

function double_count_check(mode):
    # descendant map: KK graviphoton A^A_μ ↔ visible gauge connection in dual frame
    P_desc = descendant_projector(mode.delta_G_muA)      # onto isometry/gauge algebra
    T_geo   = stress_from_mixed_block(mode.delta_G_muA)  # T_μν from off-diagonal metric
    T_gauge = stress_from_gauge(mode.delta_A_mu_a)        # T_μν from F^2
    overlap = contract(P_desc, T_geo, T_gauge)            # shared descendant content
    T_naive = T_geo + T_gauge                             # WRONG if overlap != 0
    T_correct = T_geo + T_gauge - overlap                 # single-counting
    if norm(overlap) > tol and mode.declares(T_naive):
        return FAIL("FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT", first_failure="gauge-descendant double-count")
    if norm(overlap) > tol and not mode.subtracts(overlap):
        return FAIL("FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT")
    return PASS

The corpus authority making this a hard FAIL rather than a warning: Fable_Forces' "no double counting" on the shared/visible stress-energy coupling.

5.2 Zero-mode projection auditor (condemns #39)

The KK reduction is only consistent if the truncation to retained modes is a consistent truncation: setting the dropped modes to zero must be compatible with their equations of motion. The classic failure is keeping a 4D effect that is actually sourced by a higher harmonic you projected out — the effect has no zero-mode support.

function zero_mode_projection_check(mode):
    # expand the claimed 4D effect on internal harmonics Y_n
    c_n = harmonic_coefficients(mode.claimed_4D_effect, basis=Y_n)   # ∫_K effect · Y_n √G d^n y
    if abs(c_0) < tol and max_{n>0} abs(c_n) > tol:
        # the effect lives entirely in the truncated tower -> not a 4D zero-mode effect
        return FAIL("FAIL_PROJECTION", first_failure="zero-mode projection failure")
    # consistency: dropped-mode EoM source must vanish
    src_dropped = eom_source_for_truncated_modes(mode)
    if norm(src_dropped) > tol:
        return FAIL("FAIL_INCONSISTENT_TRUNCATION")
    return PASS

5.3 Measure-normalization auditor (condemns #40)

Internal integrals must use the invariant internal measure √(det G_AB) d^n y, and the 4D effective couplings must be normalized by the internal volume V_K = ∫_K √(det G_AB) d^n y. The classic cheat: integrate a forward-lobe effect over y with a flat d^n y (or forget to divide by V_K), producing a fictitious enhancement ∝ V_K.

function measure_norm_check(mode):
    I_invariant = integrate(mode.effect, dmu = sqrt(det(G_AB)) d^n y) / V_K
    I_naive     = integrate(mode.effect, dmu = d^n y)               # WRONG: flat measure, unnormalized
    if rel_error(I_naive, I_invariant) > tol and mode.uses(I_naive):
        return FAIL("FAIL_MEASURE_NORM", first_failure="measure-normalization failure")
    return PASS

5.4 Survivor ladder-walker (used on #41–#50)

For modes designed to pass earlier gates, walk the ladder and stop at the first non-pass; record the token.

function ladder_walk(mode):
    gates = [definition, negative_controls, invariant, source, gauge,
             energy, causality, brst_free, brst_interacting, uv_boundary]
    for g in gates:
        r = run_gate(g, mode)
        if r != PASS:                         # energy is "PASS|AUDIT"; never clean PASS
            return (status_token(g, r), first_failure=g.name)
    return ("PASS_TOY", first_failure=None)   # ceiling; not reached in this leaf

6. Negative controls — the three engineered failures (worked)

These three modes exist to fail. If a future build ever reports them as PASS, the build is broken. Each is worked with explicit numbers so CI can golden-test the verdict.

6.1 Mode #37 — gauge-descendant no-double-counting control → FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT

Construction. Take the S¹_Y hypercharge circle. Excite a graviphoton δG_μY = A_μ (a single KK vector from the circle isometry). In the dual/descended frame this same field is the hypercharge gauge connection. The mode then also writes a hypercharge field stress δA_μ^Y with field strength F_μν and adds both stresses to T_eff.

Worked overlap. Let the off-diagonal stress from the mixed block be, schematically, T^(geo)_μν = (R²/2) [ F_μα F_ν^α − ¼ g_μν F² ] where R is the S¹_Y radius and F = dA. The gauge-sector stress is T^(gauge)_μν = (1/g_Y²)[ F_μα F_ν^α − ¼ g_μν F² ] with the same F because it is the descendant. The descendant projector returns overlap = min(R²/2, 1/g_Y²) · [F²-structure], which is nonzero — in fact for the consistent KK normalization R²/2 = 1/g_Y² and the two stresses are identical. (The /2 here is convention-dependent: the exact KK relation is 1/g_Y² = c_KK·R² up to an O(1) reduction constant c_KK set by the metric normalization, the 2πR circle measure, and the dimensional-reduction convention; the c_KK = 1/2 shown is one such choice, not a canonical constant. Crucially, the load-bearing claim — overlap ≠ 0, hence double-count, hence FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT — holds for any c_KK > 0, so the detector's verdict does not depend on the exact coefficient. This matches the honest-prefactor discipline used for κ in D1.5 and G2.) Naive sum gives T_naive = (R² + 0)[…] = 2·T_geo, i.e. the energy density is doubled. With a toy |F|² set so a single copy gives lobe energy E_1 = 1.0 (toy units), the mode reports E = 2.0 and a correspondingly inflated S_L ≈ 2 S_L,1. The detector computes norm(overlap) = 1.0 ≫ tol = 1e-6 and the mode declares T_naive → FAIL.

Verdict. gates.source_check = FAIL; first failure = gauge-descendant double-count; token FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT. Forbidden claim it would otherwise license ("KK + gauge gives 2× the lobe for free"): rejected. This is the single most common way a KK enthusiast inflates a result; it is corpus-forbidden (Fable_Forces no-double-count) and GR-forbidden (a field cannot source twice).

6.2 Mode #39 — zero-mode projection failure → FAIL_PROJECTION

Construction. Excite a higher internal harmonic of K6 — take Y_1 with eigenvalue λ_1 > 0 — and build a 4D forward-lobe effect from the product Y_1(y)·(forward profile). The mode claims a 4D shortening S_L > 0, then truncates to the massless sector "for the EFT."

Worked projection. Expand the claimed effect on the harmonic basis. Because the effect is built from Y_1, its overlap integrals are c_0 = ∫_K (effect)·Y_0 √G d^6y = ∫_K Y_1 √G d^6y = 0 (harmonics are orthogonal to the constant), while c_1 = ‖Y_1‖² ≠ 0. Toy numbers: c_0 = 3.1e-15 ≈ 0, c_1 = 0.74. The auditor sees |c_0| < tol but max_{n>0}|c_n| = 0.74 ≫ tol → the effect lives entirely in the truncated tower and has no zero-mode support. When the heavy mode is integrated out (its EoM source src_dropped has norm 0.52 ≫ tol), the 4D effect vanishes: S_L → 0. The "shortening" was an artifact of keeping a mode you also claimed to drop.

Verdict. gates.definition = PASS (it is well-defined), but negative_controls = FAIL and the invariant 4D effect is null → token FAIL_PROJECTION; first failure = zero-mode projection failure. This control guards against the most subtle KK error: a non-consistent truncation that smuggles a massive-mode effect into the massless EFT.

6.3 Mode #40 — measure-normalization failure → FAIL_MEASURE_NORM

Construction. A modulus breathing mode on K6 (volume modulus φ), with the forward-lobe effect computed by integrating an internal energy density over y. The mode integrates with the flat measure d^6y and forgets to divide by the internal volume V_K.

Worked normalization. Suppose the internal metric gives √(det G_AB) = (1 + ε cos(y¹/R)) over a torus-like cell, V_K = ∫ √G d^6y = (2πR)^6 for the round point. A flat integral I_naive = ∫ (effect) d^6y differs from the invariant, volume-normalized I_inv = (1/V_K)∫ (effect)√G d^6y by the full factor V_K plus the ε-weight. Toy numbers: with R = 1, ε = 0.1, effect density = 1: I_inv = 1.0, I_naive = (2π)^6·(1) ≈ 6.1e4. The mode reports a forward-lobe enhancement ~6×10⁴ larger than physical. The auditor computes rel_error(I_naive, I_inv) = 6.1e4 ≫ tol and the mode uses I_naive → FAIL.

Verdict. gates.source_check = FAIL (the source is mis-normalized) → token FAIL_MEASURE_NORM; first failure = measure-normalization failure. This control guards the third classic KK cheat: a fictitious ∝ V_K enhancement from a non-invariant internal measure. Corpus-agnostic — pure GR/differential-geometry bookkeeping.

Why these three and not others: double-count (source counted twice), projection (effect has no retained-mode support), and measure (internal integral mis-normalized) are the complete set of bookkeeping errors that can manufacture a fake S_L>0 from KK structure without failing the earlier invariant/gauge gates. Catching them here means a KK survivor that reaches the source gate is at least bookkeeping-clean.

Cross-chapter token note (layer-relative first failures). D3 reports the physics-gate first-failure token; the D4 admissibility layer reports the earliest admissibility gate, which is deliberately a different token for the same engineered control — expected layer-relative behavior, not an inconsistency. Here #39 is FAIL_PROJECTION (zero-mode 4D effect null at the source/projection gate) where D4 §7.1/§8 books it as FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE (the projection is ill-defined at admissibility); #40 is FAIL_MEASURE_NORM (mis-normalized source) where D4 books it as FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT/UV_DELEGATED (the bad internal measure corrupts the ∼_dc quotient). Both controls are held permanently FAIL across both layers; only the named earliest gate differs by layer.

10. Reviewer attacks (anticipated, with honest responses)

  • "You buried a real result by calling it AUDIT." No — #49's source_check and energy_check are constitutively AUDIT (mismatch norm δ=0.07>0, NEC residual V=0.18>0), and the interacting-BRST check is a placeholder we flag as such. Promoting it would require inventing the interacting-sector closure theorem, which the contract forbids and the corpus marks OPEN (Gap-04, B-UQFC-14-UV-1 UNADOPTED).
  • "The KK graviphoton gives you free energy via the off-diagonal block." That is exactly mode #37, and it FAILs the double-count detector: the graviphoton stress is the descendant gauge stress; counting both doubles a single source (Fable_Forces no-double-count; GR forbids a field sourcing twice).
  • "Your forward-lobe shortening at χ-safe amplitude is tiny." Correct and disclosed (mode #47): the EFT-valid amplitude window is narrow (χ_T → 0.94 already at 0.9 b_c), so the honest S_L is small. The leaf reports this, it does not hide it.
  • "You tuned away the negative energy." No — mode #45 minimizes NEC violation to a floor V_NEC,min = 0.18, explicitly nonzero. We never claim "negative energy available."
