The strongest honest claim is the conditional one: retained as a simulation/EFT candidate only if it later passes the declared invariant-distance, source, gauge, quantization, causality, and UV-boundary gates.

D4 — Admissibility Framework & the "Most Modes Should Fail" Doctrine

Closure status: 2 TOY_TESTED (framework) · PASS_TOY ceiling on every worked mode · Default mode status: TOY_MODEL/AUDIT

Scope note (HC-07). This chapter specifies the gatekeeper that stands in front of every candidate excitation profile Ξ_drive before any distance, source, energy, gauge, quantization, causality, or UV claim is even attempted. It is the first machine that runs and the one that rejects the most. Nothing here is a propulsion result. The deliverable is a validator, a layer-mapping engine, and a no-new-primitive / no-double-counting audit, plus the worked failure record of 50 candidate modes. The whole point of this chapter is that most of those 50 fail, by machine, for stated reasons — and that this is the source of the document's credibility, not an embarrassment to be hidden.

1. Why this challenge matters (HC-07)

Every later chapter — invariant proper-distance (D-series G1), source ledger (G2), energy-condition bookkeeping (G3), gauge-equivalence, BRST physical-state, causality, UV-boundary — assumes it is handed a well-formed candidate. "Well-formed" is not free. The single most common way a metric-engineering proposal fools itself is by quietly introducing a new ingredient: a fifth fundamental scalar that is not in the frozen geometry, a stress tensor with no Lagrangian parent, a "negative-energy fluid" placeholder, or — most insidiously — by counting the same degree of freedom twice (once as a metric perturbation δg_μν, again as the gauge field it descends from, or once as a modulus and again as the compactification radius it is).

If admissibility is not enforced first and mechanically, the downstream gates can be passed by cheating: you can always make a forward lobe contract proper distance if you are allowed to invent the source that does it. The admissibility framework is the firewall that makes the rest of the document honest. Its job is to guarantee:

  1. No new primitive. Every active field in Ξ_drive traces to a licensed parent in the frozen corpus geometry — the metric g_μν, the gauge connection A_μ^a on K_gauge, the moduli φ^I of K6 = SU(3)/T², S², S¹_Y, the BRST ghosts (c, b), and declared auxiliary/Lagrange-multiplier fields. Anything else is FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE.
  2. No double counting. A degree of freedom is counted in exactly one layer. A Kaluza–Klein descendant of A_μ^a may appear in the metric block as a mixed component δG_μA, but its dynamical content is the gauge field's, and the source ledger must not bill it twice.
  3. Layer-complete mapping. Every component of Ξ_drive lands in exactly one of eight layers: metric · mixed · internal · gauge · scalar · matter · ghost · auxiliary. An unmappable component is FAIL by definition (the projector has nowhere to put it).
  4. UV-sensitivity marking. Any component whose admissibility depends on internal/compactification data (moduli, KK towers, internal harmonics) is flagged UV_SENSITIVE and routed to UV_DELEGATED — never silently admitted.

First failure (this section). The challenge is hard precisely because the check that nothing new was added is itself a place where a bug hides: a poorly written no_new_primitive scan that pattern-matches on field names rather than on layer provenance will admit a relabeled new field (call your fifth scalar phi_3 and claim it is "a K6 mode"). The framework's own first failure is therefore provenance spoofing — and §5/§7 below build the negative control that catches exactly that.

2. Formal object — the admissibility projector 𝒫_adm

2.1 The candidate excitation

We take the standard excitation object from the corpus build contract:

Ξ_drive(t,x) = { δg_μν,  δA_μ^a,  δφ^I,  δG_μA,  δG_AB,  Σ_state,  Σ_gauge }

where δg_μν is the 4D metric perturbation, δA_μ^a the gauge-connection perturbation (a adjoint index of K_gauge), δφ^I the moduli/scalar perturbations (I runs over the frozen moduli set), δG_μA, δG_AB the mixed and internal blocks of the higher-dimensional metric (A,B internal indices on K6 × S² × S¹_Y), and Σ_state, Σ_gauge the BRST/state and gauge-fixing data.

2.2 The eight layers and the licensed-parent map

Define the layer set L and the license map λ from a component to its corpus parent:

Layer Symbol Component pattern Licensed parent (corpus anchor) UV-class
metric M δg_μν Einstein-frame g_μν (Fable_Forces, single metric) UV-safe
mixed X δG_μA KK reduction of higher-D metric → descends to A_μ^a UV-sensitive
internal N δG_AB, internal harmonics K6=SU(3)/T², S², S¹_Y geometry (Fable_GUT) UV-sensitive
gauge G δA_μ^a connection on K_gauge (Fable_GUT/Forces) UV-safe*
scalar S δφ^I (frozen moduli) moduli of frozen compactification UV-sensitive
matter T δψ, visible stress L_matter, shared/visible T_μν (Fable_Forces) UV-safe
ghost C δc, δb BRST (c,b) pair (Fable_Quantum) audit
auxiliary A Lagrange mult. δλ_k, gauge-fix δη declared L_constraint, gauge-fixing sector UV-safe

* Gauge is UV-safe as a 4D field but UV-sensitive whenever its origin is a KK descendant — see the double-count rule (§4).

The license map is partial: λ: components ⇀ (parent, layer). A component with no image under λ is unlicensed.

2.3 The projector

The admissibility projector is the idempotent map

𝒫_adm : Ξ_drive  ↦  Π_adm · Ξ_drive

where Π_adm = Π_freeze · Π_chamber · Π_layer · Π_dup is the ordered composition of four sub-projectors:

  • Π_layer — keeps only components with a defined λ-image (a layer + licensed parent). Kernel ⇒ FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE.
  • Π_freeze — keeps only perturbations consistent with the frozen geometry: the parent compactification M4 × K_gauge × F+ is not re-selected, re-stabilized, or re-chosen by the perturbation. Kernel ⇒ FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE/UV_DELEGATED.
  • Π_chamber — keeps only perturbations that remain inside the admissibility chamber F+ (no chamber-wall crossing, no unlicensed modulus runaway). Kernel ⇒ FAIL_CHAMBER.
  • Π_dup — quotients by the double-count equivalence ∼_dc (a KK descendant is identified with its 4D parent; a modulus is identified with the radius it parametrizes). Non-trivial collapse billed once ⇒ pass; billed twice ⇒ FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT.

Idempotence (a real invariant we test): 𝒫_adm ∘ 𝒫_adm = 𝒫_adm. Re-running admissibility on an already-admitted mode must change nothing. A framework that fails idempotence is silently mutating modes — a defect we treat as a hard test failure (§6, NC-IDEM).

First failure (this section). Π_freeze and Π_chamber both depend on internal (compactification) data that the platform holds only as configuration, not as a proven UV completion. So the projector cannot, by itself, certify that a chamber-respecting mode is globally admissible — it can only certify it is admissible relative to the frozen configuration. The honest first failure of 𝒫_adm is therefore relative-not-absolute admissibility: a PASS from 𝒫_adm is a PASS_TOY conditioned on the corpus configuration, and any internal-layer dependence forces UV_DELEGATED. We never upgrade past this.

2.4 The chamber-admissibility projector Π_chamber, the chamber-wall crossing detector, and the F+-as-filter (not-knob) rule

The sub-projector Π_chamber is the load-bearing native-13D object in Π_adm, and it is the one most easily abused, so we specify it explicitly here. F+ is the positive Weyl/holonomy admissibility chamber of the frozen parent 𝓜_parent = M4 × K_gauge × F+. It is a dim-0 label, not a coordinate factor and not a continuous field (dimension bookkeeping: dim 𝓜_parent = 4 + 9 + 0 = 13; F+ contributes 0 coordinates — see C3.2.1). Its sole job is to decide membership: which branch is active, which candidates are admissible, which perturbations cross a chamber wall, which perturbations would introduce a new primitive, and which source templates are illegal. It carries no stress-energy of its own and contributes nothing to the forward-distance score S_L (it gates membership before the L_F integral runs).

The F+-as-filter (not-knob) rule (binding).

Native chamber rule:
F+ is an admissibility chamber, not a coordinate or a continuous physical field. A candidate may be
projected INTO F+, tested AGAINST F+, or rejected BY F+. It may NOT excite F+ as a hidden propulsion
knob, treat the chamber label as a tunable modulus, or book "chamber energy" into S_L. Any candidate
that treats chamber selection as a physical source is chamber abuse and is downgraded BEFORE the
source gate ever runs → FAIL_CHAMBER (or FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE when the abuse asserts an off-menu
degree of freedom).

This is the dim-0 fact stated operationally: there is no continuous coordinate f ∈ F+ to differentiate, so there is no ∂(anything)/∂F+ a candidate could turn into a force. A "chamber gradient" is a category error, and the validator is built to catch it rather than to silently evaluate it.

The chamber-wall crossing detector (Π_chamber, operational form). Π_chamber keeps a perturbation iff it stays inside the same admissibility chamber the frozen parent selected — no chamber-wall crossing and no unlicensed modulus runaway. Pseudocode (consistent with the chamber_ok call in the §5.5 driver):

function chamber_wall_crossing(card):
    # branch_label is the frozen chamber the parent selected (config; pinned by the freeze hash)
    parent_branch = FROZEN_CONFIG.F_plus_branch                  # a discrete label, NOT a coordinate
    for comp in card.active_components:
        if asserts_continuous_F_plus_dof(comp):                  # treats the chamber as a tunable field/knob
            return FAIL_CHAMBER, "chamber-as-knob"               # ⊂ chamber abuse
        if books_stress_to_F_plus(card.source_ansatz, comp):     # "chamber energy" into the ledger / S_L
            return FAIL_CHAMBER, "chamber-as-source"             # ⊂ chamber abuse
        branch = walk_holonomy(parent_branch, comp)              # where does this perturbation land?
        if branch != parent_branch:
            if unlicensed_modulus_runaway(comp):                 # crossed by driving a frozen modulus past F+
                return FAIL_CHAMBER, "wall-crossing-by-runaway"
            return FAIL_CHAMBER, "chamber-wall-crossing"         # left the admissible chamber
    return PASS                                                  # remained inside F+ (necessary, NOT sufficient)

asserts_continuous_F_plus_dof and books_stress_to_F_plus are the chamber-abuse / claim-risk scanner: they fire whenever a candidate tries to convert the dim-0 selection label into a physical lever. walk_holonomy is the wall-crossing geometry: a perturbation that drives a frozen modulus (e.g. a_K6, a_S2, R_Y) far enough to flip the holonomy/Weyl branch has left the chamber the parent froze, even if every individual field is licensed. This is exactly the negative control NC-CHAMBER (§6) and library mode #27 (F+ chamber perturbation, FAIL_CHAMBER), with the smuggled-modulus variant #30; both stay permanently FAIL and neither contributes to any survivor count.

How the three native first-failure tokens are tied to the 7-step protocol. Π_chamber is the chamber stage of the native candidate protocol (Step 3 layer assignment + Step 4 projection, Π_adm = Π_freeze · Π_chamber · Π_layer · Π_dup). The three structural rejection tokens fire as follows, each before the energy/EFT gates of Step 6 can be reached:

Native token Trigger (native protocol stage) Π_adm sub-projector
FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE Step 3: a component with no ×/⊕/⊗ layer / no λ-image; an off-menu field (e.g. a 13th gauge index with no parent isometry); a frozen-block edit or background drift; or a chamber abuse that asserts an off-menu DOF Π_layer / Π_freeze
FAIL_CHAMBER Step 3/4: F+ excited as a continuous knob, "chamber energy" booked into S_L, or a chamber-wall crossing / unlicensed modulus runaway Π_chamber
FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT Step 3: a single descendant assigned to two layers; or (per the canon register split) claiming both a ⊕ "projected-out" pass and a ⊗ stress credit for the same descendant with the same provenance Π_dup

The ordering is itself a correctness property: a candidate that cheats with a new primitive or a chamber knob is rejected at admissibility and never reaches the source ledger (Step 5) or the NEC/WEC/SEC/DEC and χ_R/χ_K/χ_T/χ_grad/χ_source/χ_max gates (Step 6). Fail-closed is the whole point — the firewall runs first and rejects the most.

First failure (this section). Π_chamber consults the frozen F+ branch label as configuration, not as a proven vacuum selection. So it can certify a perturbation stays inside the declared chamber, but it cannot certify the declared chamber is the true one — that is the same UNADOPTED-UV (B-UQFC-14-UV-1 / Gap-04) boundary that caps the whole framework. The honest first failure of the chamber projector is therefore chamber-relativity: a chamber-respecting PASS is PASS_TOY relative to the frozen F+, and any dependence on the internal/holonomy data routes to UV_DELEGATED rather than an absolute admission. This keeps the chamber rule a filter, never a source — exactly the dim-0 discipline it must be.

3. Corpus authority block

The geometry object (parent compactification, chamber F+) exists and is frozen Fable_GUT "the geometry exists; admissibility/freeze discipline is defined" working-drive proof, UV completion, hardware

The eight manuscript layers (metric/mixed/internal/gauge/scalar/matter/ghost/auxiliary) are the refinement of the contract's three structural layers ×/⊕/⊗: structural-× (geometric base) splits into {metric, mixed, internal}; structural-⊕ (admissibility/projection/chamber) is what 𝒫_adm is; structural-⊗ (bundles/operators/quantization) splits into {gauge, scalar, ghost, auxiliary, matter}. This refinement is bookkeeping, not new physics, and is asserted as such.

First failure (this section). The corpus is not peer-reviewed, and the build contract says so explicitly. Therefore every admissibility verdict that relies on a corpus-specific object (chamber F+, the specific moduli set, the SU(3)/T² harmonics) inherits the corpus's unproven status. The first failure of the authority block is unrefereed provenance: where we can phrase a check corpus-agnostically (against plain GR/EFT — e.g. "does this component have any Lagrangian parent and a stress tensor T_μν = −(2/√−g) δS/δg^μν?"), we prefer that, and we flag every corpus-only check as AUDIT.

4. Closure target & the no-double-counting algebra

4.1 Closure target

Produce a unified candidate-mode schema with (a) layer assignments for all eight layers, (b) a no-new-primitive scan that rejects any unlicensed field, and (c) a no-double-counting audit that bills each degree of freedom to exactly one layer. Mark every internal-layer dependence UV_SENSITIVE. Ceiling: framework reaches TOY_TESTED; every mode evaluated by it is capped at PASS_TOY.

4.2 The double-count equivalence ∼_dc

The subtle gate. Under KK reduction, the higher-dimensional metric block δG_μA is not an independent field from the 4D gauge field δA_μ^a; it descends to it:

δG_μA(x,y)  =  Σ_n  A_μ^{(n)}(x) · Y_n^A(y)      (KK tower, Y_n internal harmonics)

so the physical content of δG_μA at zero mode n=0 is δA_μ^a. The double-count audit imposes the equivalence

δG_μA  ∼_dc  δA_μ^a      (mixed zero-mode identified with gauge field)
δφ^I   ∼_dc  R_I         (modulus identified with the compactification length/volume it sets)

and defines the billing rule: the source ledger (chapter G2) receives a contribution from a ∼_dc equivalence class once, attributed to its canonical representative (the lowest-layer representative in the order gauge < mixed, internal-radius < scalar-modulus). If a candidate's source ansatz sums over both δG_μA and its descendant δA_μ^a as independent stresses, the audit returns FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT.

4.3 Worked micro-number (so the rule is not abstract)

Take a toy mixed mode whose only excitation is the zero-mode A_μ^{(0)} with effective 4D energy density ρ_G computed from the mixed block δG_μA, and separately a gauge stress ρ_A computed from δA_μ^a for the same zero mode. Because they are the same DOF, an honest ledger has total ρ = ρ_A (or equivalently ρ_G, with ρ_G = ρ_A up to the harmonic normalization ∫_K |Y_0|² = 1). A double-counting ansatz writes ρ_naive = ρ_A + ρ_G = 2 ρ_A. The audit flags the factor: ρ_naive / ρ_canonical = 2.0, which is exactly the signature FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT looks for (ratio ≠ 1 for a single equivalence class). This is mode #37 in the library (§9), and its expected first failure is double counting — by construction.

First failure (this section). The ∼_dc quotient is only as good as the harmonic normalization ∫_K Y_m Y_n = δ_mn. If the internal measure is mis-normalized (mode #40, "measure-normalization failure"), the descendant identification δG_μA ∼ δA_μ carries a wrong factor and the de-duplication under- or over-corrects. So the first failure of the no-double-counting algebra is measure-normalization dependence — itself a UV_SENSITIVE quantity routed to UV_DELEGATED. We never claim the quotient is exact; we claim it is exact given a declared, frozen internal measure and AUDIT otherwise.

5. Algorithms (pseudocode)

The framework is four functions over a ModeCard. Field names follow the HC-07 build artifacts (mode_card.py, layer_assignment.py, no_new_primitive.py).

5.1 Mode card schema

ModeCard:
  mode_id            : str            # "MID-..."
  family             : str            # one of the 5 families
  active_components  : list[Component]# each: {symbol, indices, provenance_claim}
  metric_ansatz      : expr
  source_ansatz      : expr | None    # None => source_check cannot PASS
  layer_assignment   : dict[Component -> Layer]  # filled by assign_layers()
  uv_flags           : set[Component]
  gates              : GateCard

5.2 Layer assignment (assign_layers)

function assign_layers(card):
    for comp in card.active_components:
        parent, layer = LICENSE_MAP.lookup(comp.symbol, comp.indices, comp.provenance_claim)
        if parent is None:
            card.layer_assignment[comp] = UNMAPPABLE        # -> NO_NEW_PRIMITIVE will FAIL
            continue
        # PROVENANCE CHECK (defeats name-spoofing, the framework's own first failure):
        if not provenance_consistent(comp, parent):
            # e.g. a scalar claiming to be a K6 harmonic but with no internal index structure
            card.layer_assignment[comp] = SPOOFED           # -> FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE
            continue
        card.layer_assignment[comp] = layer
        if layer in {INTERNAL, MIXED, SCALAR} or descends_from_KK(comp):
            card.uv_flags.add(comp)                          # UV_SENSITIVE marking
    return card

provenance_consistent is the crux: it checks that a component claiming a parent actually carries that parent's index structure and transformation law (a real K6 harmonic carries internal indices A,B and transforms under the SU(3)/T² isometry; a relabeled flat scalar does not). This is what defeats provenance spoofing (§1, §7 NC-SPOOF).

5.3 No-new-primitive scan (no_new_primitive)

function no_new_primitive(card):
    n_fields_used = count_independent_dofs(card, modulo = DC_EQUIV)  # ∼_dc applied first
    if any(layer is UNMAPPABLE or SPOOFED for layer in card.layer_assignment.values()):
        return FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE
    if n_fields_used > LICENSED_DOF_BUDGET:        # frozen corpus DOF count
        return FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE                  # smuggled a 5th field as a "combination"
    return PASS

LICENSED_DOF_BUDGET is the counted number of independent licensed degrees of freedom in the frozen geometry. Counting modulo ∼_dc before comparing to the budget is what stops the "I only used existing fields, but five of them, where the frozen geometry has four" smuggle (the canonical arbitrary-fifth-field acceptance test, HC-07).

5.4 No-double-counting audit (no_double_count)

function no_double_count(card):
    classes = partition(card.active_components, by = DC_EQUIV)   # ∼_dc classes
    for cls in classes:
        billed = [c for c in cls if appears_in(card.source_ansatz, c)]
        if len(billed) > 1:
            ratio = source_weight(card, cls) / canonical_weight(card, cls)
            return FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT, ratio        # ratio ~ 2.0 for a clean duplicate
    return PASS

5.5 The admissibility driver

function admit(card):
    card = assign_layers(card)
    if (r := no_new_primitive(card))     != PASS: return downgrade(r)          # FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE
    if (r := no_double_count(card))[0]   != PASS: return downgrade(FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT, r[1])
    if not chamber_ok(card):                       return downgrade(FAIL_CHAMBER)
    if card.uv_flags:                              return UV_DELEGATED(card)    # internal dependence
    assert admit(card) == card           # IDEMPOTENCE invariant (NC-IDEM)
    return PASS_TOY(card)                 # ceiling: NEVER higher than PASS_TOY

Note the terminal line: the strongest verdict the driver can ever emit is PASS_TOY. There is no code path to PASS, EFT_CANDIDATE, or any physical claim. Promotion past PASS_TOY requires owner/attorney escalation and is structurally absent from the validator (build contract §1.4).

First failure (this section). chamber_ok and descends_from_KK both consult corpus configuration. If that configuration is wrong (the frozen geometry is not the true vacuum), the validator is consistently wrong in a way it cannot self-detect. The first failure of the algorithm is silent-configuration error: the validator is sound relative to its config and cannot certify the config. We mitigate by running corpus-agnostic checks first (a component with source_ansatz = None fails on Lagrangian-parent grounds regardless of corpus) and AUDIT-flagging the corpus-only branches.

6. Negative controls

A validator that never rejects is worthless; a validator that rejects everything is also worthless. Negative controls prove the framework discriminates. Each control is a deliberately broken input with a known correct verdict; the framework passes the control iff it returns that verdict.

ID Negative control input Correct verdict What it proves
NC-PRIM An arbitrary 5th fundamental scalar χ_new with no λ-image FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE the scan rejects unlicensed fields (HC-07 acceptance test #1)
NC-SPOOF A flat scalar relabeled phi_K6 claiming to be a K6 harmonic, no internal indices FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE (spoofed) provenance check beats name-spoofing (the framework's own first failure)
NC-DC A mode billing δG_μA and its zero-mode descendant δA_μ^a as independent stresses FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT, ratio≈2.0 the de-dup audit fires (HC-07 acceptance test #2)
NC-UV A pure internal δG_AB harmonic (mode #33) UV_DELEGATED, UV_SENSITIVE set internal modes are marked, not admitted (HC-07 acceptance test #3)
NC-IDEM Any already-admitted mode, re-run output identical idempotence 𝒫²=𝒫 holds
NC-CHAMBER A modulus perturbation that crosses the F+ chamber wall (mode #27) FAIL_CHAMBER chamber discipline enforced
NC-TRIV The zero excitation Ξ=0 PASS_TOY but flagged trivial the projector does not reject the null mode, yet a trivial pass is watermarked so it can't masquerade as a result

NC-TRIV deserves a word: a coordinate transform (mode #1) and the zero excitation both pass admissibility — and should — because they introduce no new primitive and double-count nothing. They then fail downstream (the invariant-distance gate G1 returns "no invariant effect"). Admissibility is necessary, not sufficient. A framework that "rejected" a coordinate transform here would be wrong; the right place to kill a coordinate-only mode is the invariant gate, with token FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY. This separation of concerns is itself a correctness property.

First failure (this section). The controls are finite. They demonstrate the validator rejects the known failure shapes; they cannot prove it rejects all malformed inputs (the space of malformed Ξ is unbounded). The first failure of the negative-control suite is incomplete coverage — an adversary can in principle construct a malformation not in {PRIM, SPOOF, DC, UV, CHAMBER}. The honest claim is "the validator passes these seven controls," not "the validator is complete." Closing this requires a property-based generator (random malformed modes) — a declared next step (§12), not a present claim.

7. Candidate-mode results (gate cards)

We ran the admissibility framework over the 50-mode library (doc 21). The headline number is the doctrine: most modes fail admissibility or are routed to UV_DELEGATED; a small remainder pass admissibility only to fail downstream. This is the intended outcome.

7.1 Aggregate verdict (admissibility layer only)

Verdict at admissibility Count / 50 Meaning
FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE 3 unlicensed/spoofed field or DOF over budget
FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT 2 a DOF billed twice
FAIL_CHAMBER 2 chamber-wall crossing / unlicensed modulus runaway
UV_DELEGATED (UV_SENSITIVE) 17 internal/modulus/KK dependence — routed, not admitted
PASS_TOY (admissible; then tested downstream) 26 well-formed; not a physics result

(Counts are read directly off the §8 ledger and sum to 3+2+2+17+26 = 50; no mode is invented to make a category total.)

Cross-chapter token note (layer-relative first failures). D4 reports the admissibility-layer first failure; the downstream physics chapters (D2/D3) report the physics-gate first failure, and for three engineered negative controls these are deliberately different tokens for the same mode — this is the expected layer-relative behavior ("first failure = earliest gate, not worst," and the earliest admissibility gate differs from the earliest physics gate). Specifically: #39 is FAIL_NEW_PRIMITIVE here (the zero-mode projection is ill-defined at admissibility) but FAIL_PROJECTION in D3 §6.2 (the zero-mode 4D effect is null at the source gate); #40 is FAIL_DOUBLE_COUNT/UV_DELEGATED here (a mis-normalized internal measure corrupts the ∼_dc quotient, §4.4) but FAIL_MEASURE_NORM in D3 §6.3 (the source is mis-normalized at the measure gate); #30 is FAIL_CHAMBER here (the smuggled modulus crosses the F+ chamber wall) but the χ-cutoff FAIL_BACKREACTION in D2 (the modulus breaches the χ≥1 backreaction cutoff). In every case the control is held permanently FAIL across both layers — no token divergence lets it escape to a passing status; only the named earliest gate differs by layer.

Of the 26 that pass admissibility, the build contract guarantees none rises above PASS_TOY, and the downstream gates (G1 invariant distance, G2 source, G3 energy) are where the population thins further — by design. Admissibility's job was only to guarantee the 26 are well-posed questions, not correct answers.

10. Patent extraction

The admissibility framework is the most portable asset in the document because it is corpus-agnostic at its core: a layer-assignment engine plus no-new-primitive and no-double-counting audits is useful for any metric-engineering or modified-gravity screening pipeline, independent of whether the Fable/TOE corpus is correct.

Four extractable assets:

  1. Unified excitation data model (ModeCard + eight-layer mapping with licensed-parent provenance). Claim shape: a computer-implemented data structure representing a candidate spacetime-and-field excitation, in which every component is bound to exactly one of a fixed set of structural layers via a license map carrying a parent-field provenance, such that components lacking a license-map image are machine-rejected.
  2. Layer-assignment + UV-marking engine (assign_layers with provenance_consistent and automatic UV_SENSITIVE flagging of internal/mixed/scalar layers). Claim shape: a method for marking, in a screening pipeline, those excitation components whose admissibility depends on compactification/UV data, and routing them to a delegated-status branch rather than admitting them.
  3. No-double-counting audit (∼_dc quotient + canonical-representative billing + the ratio≈2.0 duplicate signature). Claim shape: a method for detecting duplicate accounting of a single physical degree of freedom across a metric/mixed and a gauge representation by partitioning components into descent-equivalence classes and billing a source ledger once per class.
  4. Chamber-admissibility projector + chamber-abuse / claim-risk scanner (Π_chamber + chamber_wall_crossing of §2.4). This bundles four sub-assets that operate on a dimension-zero admissibility chamber held as frozen configuration: (a) a chamber-admissibility projector that admits a candidate iff it remains inside the chamber the frozen background selected; (b) a chamber-wall crossing detector that rejects a candidate which drives a frozen modulus across a holonomy/Weyl branch wall; (c) a fail-closed mode-rejection system keyed to admissibility-chamber violations, emitting FAIL_CHAMBER before any source/energy gate runs; and (d) a claim-risk scanner that flags chamber abuse — treating the dimension-zero chamber label as a tunable knob, or booking "chamber energy" into the source ledger / distance score. Claim shape: a method for screening candidate field-excitation profiles against a discrete admissibility-chamber label carried by a frozen background, comprising projecting each profile onto the chamber the background selected, detecting chamber-wall crossings induced by modulus runaway, rejecting profiles that assert the chamber label as a continuous physical degree of freedom or attribute stress-energy to it, and routing chamber-relative admissions to a delegated status rather than an absolute admission.

All four are simulation/software assets with option value regardless of any propulsion outcome — exactly the build contract's "patentable simulation/control assets useful either way."

First failure (this section). Patent novelty over prior art (general EFT consistency checkers, field-content auditors in lattice/SUGRA codes) is not established here — that is a legal/prior-art search, not a physics result. The first failure of the patent extraction is unsearched novelty; the honest claim is "these are extractable, reduced-to-practice software methods," not "these are novel and patentable."

11. Reviewer attacks (the strongest objections, answered honestly)

Attack A — "Your projector just launders the corpus's assumptions; admissibility is circular." Honest response: partly true and stated as such. Π_freeze/Π_chamber are corpus-relative; a PASS_TOY is explicitly conditioned on the frozen configuration and any internal dependence forces UV_DELEGATED. The corpus-agnostic core (no unlicensed field, no missing Lagrangian parent, no double count) survives even if the specific compactification is wrong — that part is plain EFT bookkeeping, not Fable-specific.

Attack B — "26 modes pass — you have 26 candidate drives." Honest response: no. PASS_TOY at admissibility means well-posed, not correct. Every passing card's strongest_allowed_claim begins "at admissibility ONLY," energy_check is never a clean PASS, and the downstream G1/G2/G3 gates thin the set further. Admissibility is necessary, not sufficient.

Attack C — "Provenance spoofing defeats you: I rename my new field as a K6 harmonic." Honest response: this is the framework's own declared first failure, and provenance_consistent is the answer — a real K6 harmonic must carry internal indices and transform under SU(3)/T². But the check is finite; we route ambiguous provenance to AUDIT, not PASS_TOY, and require the Lagrangian term be exhibited, not merely named.

Attack D — "The 50 modes are hand-picked to fail nicely." Honest response: they are designed per doc 21 with expected first failures — that is the doctrine, not a trick. The defense against cherry-picking is the declared next step: a property-based generator producing random malformed modes (§12). Until that runs, we claim only "passes the seven named negative controls," not completeness.

Strongest single objection + response. The single strongest attack is B (the survivor-count illusion) because it is the easiest misread by a hopeful reader, including the recipient. The response is structural, not rhetorical: there is no code path in the validator to any status above PASS_TOY, and the chapter's terminal closure status is itself capped. The framework cannot, by construction, hand anyone a "drive."

E01a — HC-01 Invariant Distance-Shortening — Object & Closure Target

Closure status: 2 TOY_TESTED (this leaf: the closure target is defined, corpus-anchored, and exercised against one pure-coordinate negative control which it correctly rejects; the strong closure path is specified but not executed here — that is E01b) · ceiling for this leaf = PASS_TOY · Default mode status: TOY_MODEL/AUDIT · First failure (chapter): the forward-lobe proper-distance reduction S_L vanishes or becomes coordinate-only under invariant diagnostics → FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY.

1. Why this challenge matters: coordinate-only artifacts are the danger

HC-01 is the first hard challenge for a structural reason: it is the challenge a metric-interface drive fails first and fails cheapest. The source document states the difficulty in one line (04_HC-01_INVARIANT_DISTANCE-SHORTENING.md, line 9):

"A coordinate transformation can make coordinate distances appear shorter without changing physical geometry."

This is not a subtle objection. It is the single most common way that any "the distance ahead of the ship got smaller" claim is worthless, and it is worth being precise about why, because the precision is what licenses every later gate.

A spacetime is a manifold M with a metric g; coordinates x^μ are an arbitrary chart, a labelling with no physical content. Diffeomorphism invariance — the defining gauge symmetry of general relativity — says that the physics is unchanged under any smooth invertible relabelling x^μ → x'^μ(x). Under such a relabelling the coordinate interval Δx^1 between two points can be made as small (or as large) as one likes:

choose   x'^1 = φ(x^1),    φ smooth, monotone, φ'(x^1) > 0
then     Δx'^1 = φ(b) − φ(a)   can be any positive number,
while    the proper distance  L = ∫ √(g_11) dx^1   is invariant.

Concretely: take flat Minkowski space and the two events "nose of the ship" and "Mars," 2.25×10¹¹ m apart at closest approach. Define a new radial coordinate x'^1 = arctan(x^1 / R) for some scale R. The coordinate separation between nose and Mars is now bounded by π/2 no matter how far away Mars is — a "coordinate distance" of order unity for a physical separation of an astronomical unit. Nothing has happened. No clock ticks differently; no light ray arrives sooner; the proper distance integral ∫√(g_11)dx'^1 rises exactly to compensate, because g_11 transforms as g'_11 = g_11 (dx^1/dx'^1)^2. The "shortening" is entirely in the labels.

This is the danger of coordinate-only artifacts, and it has a sharper, more seductive cousin that catches careful people: the conformal/frame artifact. A Weyl rescaling g̃_{μν} = Ω²(x) g_{μν} is not a coordinate change — it is a genuinely different metric — and it does change proper distances: L̃ = ∫ Ω √(g_{11}) dx^1. If one is permitted to choose which conformal frame is "physical," one can manufacture an apparent forward shortening that is pure frame choice. This is why the corpus single-Einstein-frame rule (Fable_Forces; installed in C1.2) is load-bearing: there is exactly one physical metric, the Einstein-frame metric, and the proper-distance functional is evaluated only in it. A candidate that shortens distance only after a Weyl rescaling is FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY (frame variant).

There is a third, subtler artifact still: the tetrad-gauge artifact. The vehicle-comoving notion of "forward" is carried by an orthonormal frame e^a_μ (C2.2.1), defined only up to a local Lorentz rotation e^a_μ → Λ^a_b(x) e^b_μ. A reported "forward distance" that changes when the frame is rotated was never a geometric quantity; it was a choice of how to point. So the artifact taxonomy HC-01 must defeat has three members, in increasing order of subtlety:

Artifact class Transformation that fakes it Detector Downgrade token
Coordinate (diffeo) x^μ → x'^μ(x) scalar invariants {R, R_{μν}R^{μν}, K, C²} unchanged FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY
Frame (Weyl/conformal) g_{μν} → Ω²(x) g_{μν} evaluate L_F only in Einstein frame; S_L collapses out of frame FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY (frame variant)
Tetrad (local Lorentz) e^a_μ → Λ^a_b(x) e^b_μ invariants bit-stable under Λ(x) reject as tetrad-gauge artifact

The deep point — the one that makes HC-01 the first challenge rather than a footnote — is this: a distance is not, by itself, an invariant of a spacetime. "The distance to Mars" depends on a choice of spatial slice, a choice of frame, and a choice of path. Special relativity already taught this with length contraction: two inertial observers disagree on the length of the same rod, and both are right, because length is a frame-relative quantity, not a geometric scalar. A metric-interface drive that "shortens the distance to Mars" is therefore not automatically doing anything — until we have pinned down a distance functional that (a) is anchored to a physically realizable frame, (b) is invariant under the residual gauge freedoms of that anchoring, and (c) is sensitive to curvature, the one thing coordinates cannot fake. HC-01's whole job is to build that functional and then to prove, by negative control, that a pure-coordinate "win" is mechanically rejected.

First failure (this section). A reader (or a generator) who reports "coordinate distance to the target decreased" as evidence of a drive has committed the canonical HC-01 failure. The honest status of such a report is FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY, full stop, before any energy, source, or causality question is even reached. The section's first failure is therefore definitional: coordinate distance is not a closure object; only a curvature-sensitive, frame-anchored, gauge-invariant proper-distance functional can be.

2. The formal object: the proper-distance functional and the shortening score

We now state precisely what HC-01 is trying to reduce. The full construction of the worldtube, comoving tetrad, forward lobe F_τ(D,ρ), and shortening score S_L is carried out in chapter C2; E01a's task is to (i) restate the object at exactly the level of detail needed to state the closure target, (ii) fix the notation that the HC-01 gates consume, and (iii) make explicit which features of the object are the anti-artifact defenses. We reproduce the formal-object block in the HC-01 source notation (04_HC-01...md, lines 47–55):

worldline        z_mu(tau)            timelike, u^mu = dz/dtau, g_munu u^mu u^nu = -1
vehicle tetrad   e_a_mu               Fermi-Walker transported, e_0 = u (comoving rest frame)
forward heading  n^mu = e_1_mu        unit spacelike, g_munu n^mu u^nu = 0, n.n = +1
forward lobe     F_tau(D, rho)        comoving shaped region ahead of the ship
metric           g_munu              the single Einstein-frame metric
candidate exc.   Xi_drive = {dg_munu, dA_mu^a, dphi^I, dG_muA, dG_AB, gauge/state}
effective source T_eff_munu = M_Pl^2 G_munu[g]   the stress-energy the metric DEMANDS
gate-card status object              {definition, invariant, source, gauge, energy, causality, uv}

2.1 The proper-distance functional L_F

The vehicle centerline is a timelike worldline z^μ(τ) with four-velocity u^μ = dz^μ/dτ, normalized g_{μν}u^μu^ν = −1. At each τ we attach a Fermi–Walker–transported orthonormal tetrad e^μ_â(τ) whose timelike leg is u^μ and whose first spatial leg n^μ ≡ e^μ_1̂ is the forward heading — the only "forward" with invariant meaning (C2.2.1). Fermi–Walker transport, not parallel transport, is mandatory: it is the transport law of a non-rotating, physically realizable onboard gyro-stabilized frame, so the heading encodes the crew's own forward rather than a coordinate artifact.

The induced spatial metric on the crew's instantaneous rest space Σ_τ = u^⊥ is the projector

h_{μν} = g_{μν} + u_μ u_ν,        h_{μν} u^ν = 0.

In Fermi normal coordinates (τ, X^î) about z^μ(τ) — proper-distance coordinates along the spatial legs — the spatial 3-metric carries the curvature explicitly (C2.2.2):

γ_{îĵ}(X) = δ_{îĵ} − (1/3) R_{îk̂ĵl̂} X^k̂ X^l̂ + O(X³)

where R_{âb̂ĉd̂} is the Riemann tensor in the tetrad frame evaluated on z^μ(τ). This expansion is the heart of the object: the only deviation of γ_{îĵ} from flat δ_{îĵ} is the curvature term. A flat spacetime gives γ_{îĵ} = δ_{îĵ} to all orders in this gauge — no curvature, no distance change — which is precisely the structure that makes the negative control work in §5.

The forward proper-distance functional integrates the spatial line element along the forward heading through the lobe:

L_F[g; z, e, F_τ] = ∫_0^D √( γ_{îĵ}(X(s)) (dX^î/ds)(dX^ĵ/ds) ) ds ,
                    X^î(s) = s · n̂^î   (forward ray, n̂^î = δ^î_1 in Fermi coords).

L_F is the proper distance, as measured by the comoving crew, from the nose to the lobe depth D ahead, through the candidate geometry. It is a functional of the metric g (which contains the excitation δg), the worldline z, the tetrad e, and the lobe F_τ(D,ρ).

2.2 The shortening score S_L

The closure object proper is not L_F itself but the dimensionless shortening score comparing the candidate geometry to the background ḡ (Minkowski for the lab toy, or a declared cosmological background), holding the worldline, tetrad construction, lobe, and frame fixed:

S_L  =  ( L_F[ḡ] − L_F[g] ) / L_F[ḡ]  =  1 − L_F[g] / L_F[ḡ] .

S_L > 0 means the forward proper distance through the lobe is shorter in the candidate geometry than in the background. S_L = 0 means no shortening; S_L < 0 means lengthening (a "drag" lobe). The background L_F[ḡ] = D in flat space (Fermi coordinates make γ_{îĵ} = δ_{îĵ}), so for a flat background

S_L = 1 − (1/D) ∫_0^D √( γ_{11}(s) ) ds ,      γ_{11}(s) = 1 − (1/3) R_{1k̂1l̂} (s n̂)^k̂ (s n̂)^l̂ + O(s³).

Expanding to leading order, √γ_{11} ≈ 1 − (1/6) R_{1k̂1l̂} X^k̂ X^l̂, so

S_L ≈ (1/D) ∫_0^D (1/6) R_{1k̂1l̂}(s n̂)(s n̂) ds  ≈  (1/6) · ⟨R_{1k̂1l̂} n̂^k̂ n̂^l̂⟩ · (D²/3) · [profile factor]

— that is, S_L at leading order is a frame-frame component of the Riemann tensor, integrated along the forward ray, weighted by the lobe profile. This is the single most important structural fact in all of HC-01, and we set it apart:

S_L is, to leading order, an integral of R_{1k̂1l̂} — a tetrad-frame curvature component — over the comoving forward lobe. Curvature is a genuine geometric invariant (a tensor; its frame components are gauge-covariant and its scalar contractions are gauge-invariant). A pure coordinate change cannot create R_{1k̂1l̂} ≠ 0 from flat space, because R = 0 is a tensor equation. Therefore a nonzero S_L from a genuinely curved geometry cannot be faked by a diffeomorphism. This is what makes S_L a candidate closure object rather than a coordinate illusion — and exactly what the negative controls of §5 and §6 must verify holds in practice and name where it can still break.

The phrase "to leading order" is doing honest work: the Fermi expansion is valid for lobe depth D small compared to the curvature radius L_curv = |R|^{−1/2}. The dimensionless control parameter is (D/L_curv)² = R_{1k̂1l̂} D²; the leading-order S_L formula is trustworthy when this is ≪ 1, and a candidate that needs D ≳ L_curv to register a shortening has left the regime where this object is even defined — that is itself a named first failure (see §6.4).

2.3 The gate-card status object

Every candidate carries a gate-card (Build Contract §3). The HC-01-relevant slots are the definition, negative_controls, and invariant_check fields. HC-01 owns invariant_check: it is the gate that decides whether a reported S_L survives the artifact taxonomy of §1. Its possible values are PASS | FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY | AUDIT, and HC-01's closure is exactly the procedure that assigns one of them.

First failure (this section). If the object is defined with L_F evaluated in a coordinate chart rather than in the Fermi-normal/Einstein-frame construction — i.e. if someone integrates √(g_{11}) dx^1 in raw coordinates instead of √(γ_{îĵ}) dX^î dX^ĵ in the comoving proper-distance gauge — then S_L inherits the coordinate transformation law and the whole object collapses to FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY. The object is only meaningful because it is built from the tetrad-frame spatial metric γ_{îĵ}, whose only departure from flat is curvature.

We state exactly what the corpus licenses for HC-01 and, equally important, what it does not license. Per the Build Contract §2, where a claim can be made corpus-agnostically (against standard GR), we prefer that — and HC-01 is overwhelmingly a standard-GR challenge. The corpus enters only to fix the single-frame discipline and the layer assignments.

HC-01's entire machinery — proper distance, Fermi coordinates, Riemann components, scalar invariants, coordinate-only rejection — is standard general relativity, settled physics since 1916, independent of any speculative compactification. The corpus contributes exactly three things: (1) the single-frame discipline (which is, in any case, the standard injunction to fix a frame before computing observables), (2) the layer bookkeeping that prevents double-counting field excitations as metric levers, and (3) the status boundary that anything needing global UV stability is delegated. The strength of HC-01 is precisely that its core is corpus-agnostic: a hostile reviewer who rejects the entire Fable framework still cannot reject the claim "coordinate distance is not invariant; curvature is" — that is GR.

If a chapter leans on a corpus anchor to assert something the anchor does not license — e.g. citing Fable_GUT's frozen geometry to claim the drive exists, rather than only that the metric field exists — the claim is FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION. HC-01's corpus authority extends to the existence and single-frame evaluation of the geometry object and to the status boundaries; it never extends to a working-drive or UV claim.

5. Minimal toy closure: reject a pure-coordinate negative control

The minimal closure (04_HC-01...md, line 17): "Compute the forward-lobe proper-distance functional and reject a pure-coordinate negative control." We do this concretely, with worked numbers, on the cheapest possible setting — flat spacetime in a disguised chart — because the negative control is the deliverable. A method that cannot reject a fake is worthless on a real candidate.

5.1 The negative control: flat space in a non-Cartesian chart

Take the background and the "candidate" to be the same flat Minkowski spacetime, but write the candidate in a non-Cartesian chart so its coordinate components look nontrivial. The cleanest example is a smooth radial "squeeze":

candidate chart:   x'^1 = f(x^1),   f(x^1) = L_0 · tanh(x^1 / L_0),   f'(x^1) = sech^2(x^1/L_0) ,
                   (x'^0,x'^2,x'^3) = (x^0,x^2,x^3) .

In the primed coordinates the metric component along the heading is g'_{11} = (dx^1/dx'^1)^2 η_{11} = 1/f'(x^1)^2 = cosh^4(x^1/L_0), which is > 1 everywhere and grows fast — to a coordinate-naïve eye, "space is stretched," and a coordinate distance ∫ dx'^1 from 0 to D is f(D) = L_0 tanh(D/L_0) < D, i.e. the coordinate separation is shorter. This is exactly the trap of §1: a coordinate "shortening" Δx'^1 = L_0 tanh(D/L_0) for a physical depth D.

A naïve generator computes S_L^naive = 1 − Δx'^1/D = 1 − (L_0/D) tanh(D/L_0) and reports a positive number. For D = L_0: S_L^naive = 1 − tanh(1) = 1 − 0.7616 = 0.2384 — a 23.8% "shortening." For D = 2L_0: 1 − (1/2)tanh(2) = 1 − 0.4820 = 0.518 — a 51.8% "shortening." These are large, seductive, and entirely fake.

5.2 Why the correct functional rejects it

The HC-01 functional does not integrate dx'^1. It integrates the proper distance through the physically anchored spatial metric:

L_F[g] = ∫_0^D √( γ_{11}(X) ) dX^1 ,   computed in Fermi-normal coordinates about the worldline.

For flat spacetime, in any chart, the curvature tensor is identically zero — R^ρ_{σμν} ≡ 0 is a tensor equation, true in all coordinates — so the Fermi-normal spatial metric is γ_{îĵ} = δ_{îĵ} − (1/3)R_{îk̂ĵl̂}X^k̂X^l̂ + … = δ_{îĵ} exactly, to all orders. Therefore

L_F[g_flat in any chart] = ∫_0^D √(δ_{11}) dX^1 = D = L_F[ḡ] ,   so   S_L = 1 − D/D = 0.

The shortening is identically zero, as it must be, because nothing physical changed. The 23.8% and 51.8% "wins" of §5.1 are revealed as coordinate artifacts the moment the functional is computed correctly. Equivalently and more cheaply, the invariant gate (C2) computes the scalar invariants directly:

R[g_flat] = 0,   R_{μν}R^{μν}[g_flat] = 0,   K = R_{μνρσ}R^{μνρσ}[g_flat] = 0,   C^2 = 0   in every chart.

Since by §2.2 the leading-order S_L is (1/6D)∫ R_{1k̂1l̂}(sn̂)(sn̂) s² ds-shaped, and R ≡ 0, there is no curvature component to integrate, and S_L = 0 with no expansion needed. The invariant check (C5) reports "no nonzero invariant where shortening was claimed" → the claimed shortening is attributed to nothing geometric → FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY.

5.3 Executable form of the negative control

The acceptance test (04_HC-01...md, lines 39–41: "flat limit has zero shortening"; "pure coordinate transform rejected") is implemented as:

def test_coordinate_only_rejection():
    # background: flat Minkowski, Cartesian
    g_bg   = minkowski_cartesian()
    # "candidate": SAME flat space in a disguised (tanh-squeeze) chart
    g_cand = pushforward(minkowski_cartesian(), chart = tanh_squeeze(L0))

    # 1) coordinate-naive (the fake): integrate raw dx'^1
    S_naive = 1 - coord_interval(g_cand, 0, D) / D
    assert S_naive > 0                      # the trap is real and tempting

    # 2) HC-01 correct functional: proper distance in Fermi-normal gauge
    L_bg   = proper_distance_forward(g_bg,   worldline, tetrad, D)   # = D
    L_cand = proper_distance_forward(g_cand, worldline, tetrad, D)   # = D  (flat is flat)
    S_L    = 1 - L_cand / L_bg
    assert abs(S_L) < tol_flat              # ~0 to engine tolerance: NO shortening

    # 3) invariant attribution: no curvature anywhere
    inv = scalar_invariants_along_ray(g_cand, worldline, tetrad, D)
    assert max(abs(inv.R), abs(inv.Ric2), abs(inv.Kretschmann)) < tol_inv

    # 4) verdict: the coordinate-naive win is downgraded
    assert hc01_gate(g_cand) == "FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY"

tol_flat and tol_inv are not arbitrary: from C1.6.4 the numerical curvature engine has a finite-difference accuracy floor ~ε^{2/3} ≈ 3.7×10^{−11} (double precision, 4th-order stencil at sweet-spot h ≈ 7×10^{−3}). Honest tolerances are therefore tol_flat ≈ 10^{−9}, tol_inv ≈ 10^{−9} in curvature-scale units; claiming 10^{−14} would be fabricating precision and is itself a downgrade (C1.6.4). The convergence test (halve h, confirm the residual drops 2⁴ = 16× until the round-off floor) is the real certificate that S_L = 0 here is a true zero, not an under-resolved small number.

The frame and tetrad controls (NC-2, NC-3 of C1.7) run analogously: a non-constant Weyl rescaling that fakes a shortening collapses when L_F is re-evaluated in the Einstein frame, and a local-Lorentz rotation leaves all scalar invariants bit-stable.

5.5 A second, harder negative control: Rindler (genuine Γ ≠ 0, still flat)

The tanh-squeeze of §5.1 is a static relabelling; a sterner test is a chart in which the connection is genuinely nonzero — because that is what a careless generator mistakes for curvature. Rindler coordinates (η, ξ, y, z), the natural frame of a uniformly accelerated observer, are exactly this case:

ds² = −ξ² dη² + dξ² + dy² + dz²   (flat Minkowski, accelerated chart, ξ>0).

Here the metric is η-independent but ξ-dependent, so the Christoffels do not vanish:

Γ^η_{ηξ} = 1/ξ ,    Γ^ξ_{ηη} = ξ .

A generator that reads "Γ ≠ 0, therefore the geometry is non-trivial, therefore my forward lobe deforms space" has fallen into the deepest version of the trap — Γ is not a tensor (C1.5), and can be set to zero at any single point by a local inertial frame. The HC-01 functional and the invariant gate are unmoved:

Riemann^ρ_{σμν}[Rindler] = ∂Γ − ∂Γ + ΓΓ − ΓΓ  =  0  (each term cancels exactly),
R = 0,   R_{μν}R^{μν} = 0,   K = 0,   C² = 0,   ⇒   γ_{îĵ} = δ_{îĵ}   ⇒   S_L = 0.

Worked check (the ΓΓ cancellation the reviewer re-runs). The only candidate nonzero Riemann component is R^η_{ξηξ}. From the spine (C1.6, step 5): R^η_{ξηξ} = ∂_η Γ^η_{ξξ} − ∂_ξ Γ^η_{ηξ} + Γ^η_{ηλ}Γ^λ_{ξξ} − Γ^η_{ξλ}Γ^λ_{ηξ}. Term by term: ∂_η Γ^η_{ξξ} = 0 (no Γ^η_{ξξ}); −∂_ξ Γ^η_{ηξ} = −∂_ξ(1/ξ) = +1/ξ²; the first quadratic Γ^η_{ηλ}Γ^λ_{ξξ} = 0 (no Γ^λ_{ξξ}); the second −Γ^η_{ξλ}Γ^λ_{ηξ} = −Γ^η_{ξη}Γ^η_{ηξ} = −(1/ξ)(1/ξ) = −1/ξ². Sum: +1/ξ² − 1/ξ² = 0. The non-zero connection is exactly cancelled by its own quadratic. This is the single most instructive line in the minimal closure: it is why "Γ ≠ 0" is never evidence of anything, and why the invariant gate, not the connection, is the arbiter. A coordinate-naïve forward-distance integral in Rindler ∫√(g_{ξξ})dξ = ∫dξ = D happens to give the right answer here only because g_{ξξ}=1; change to g_{ξξ}=h(ξ) by a further relabelling and the naïve integral moves while S_L stays pinned at 0. The lesson generalizes: only the curvature-built functional is safe.

5.6 The positive control: a genuinely curved toy lobe (the contrast)

A rejection method is only trustworthy if it also returns a nonzero answer when there really is curvature — otherwise it is a method that always says "no," which is uninformative (§5's first failure). We therefore exhibit one toy curved geometry that produces S_L > 0 attributed to a real invariant, as the contrast case. Take a weak, static, localized curvature along the forward ray with tidal profile

R_{1k̂1l̂} n̂^k̂ n̂^l̂ ≡ E_1(s) = E_0 · w(s/D) ,   w(σ)=cos²(πσ/2) (raised cosine),   E_0 > 0 (focusing),

with E_0 chosen in the validity regime E_0 D² ≪ 1. From §2.2, S_L ≈ (1/6D)∫_0^D E_1(s) s² ds. With the raised-cosine window, ∫_0^D w(s/D) s² ds = D³ ∫_0^1 cos²(πσ/2) σ² dσ = D³ · (1/6 − 1/π²) ≈ D³ · 0.0653. Hence

S_L ≈ (1/6D) · E_0 · 0.0653 D³ = 0.0109 · E_0 D² .

Worked number. Pick E_0 D² = 9.0×10⁻³ (so the control parameter (D/L_curv)² = E_0 D² ≈ 0.009 ≪ 1, comfortably in the Fermi regime). Then S_L ≈ 0.0109 × 9.0×10⁻³ ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁵ — a 0.0098% genuine forward shortening. Three things distinguish this from the §5.1 fake: (i) it is tiny (a real curvature-built effect in the valid regime is small, precisely because large effects break the expansion — §6.4); (ii) it survives the diffeo/frame/tetrad controls because it is carried by a nonzero scalar invariant (K = R_{μνρσ}R^{μνρσ} ≈ 4 E_0² ≠ 0 for this Weyl-type tidal field — nonzero where S_L is generated, satisfying C5); (iii) it predicts a geodesic-focusing signal (§6.2) of matching sign and magnitude. The contrast is the whole point:

Γ nonzero? yes yes yes

6. The strong closure path: invariant curvature, geodesic deviation, source, subluminality

The strong closure (04_HC-01...md, lines 19–21): "Show nonzero invariant curvature/geodesic-deviation signal, sourced stress-energy, local subluminality, and gate-card consistency." Where the minimal closure rejects fakes, the strong closure must positively attribute a genuine S_L > 0 to curvature and cross-check it against an independent geometric diagnostic — and then hand the candidate, honestly, to the source and causality gates. We specify the path; we do not execute it on a real candidate here (that is E01b). Specifying it is what earns the closure target its credibility; executing it is what later leaves must do or downgrade.

6.1 Step A — nonzero invariant curvature signal (the positive attribution)

A candidate that passes §5's negative controls has S_L invariant under diffeo, frame, and tetrad gauge. The strong closure first demands a positive curvature certificate: somewhere along the forward ray through the lobe, a scalar curvature invariant is nonzero at the scale needed to generate the claimed S_L. We require, along the ray X(s) = s n̂, 0 ≤ s ≤ D:

(A1)  Geodesic-deviation magnitude:   E_1(s) ≡ R_{1k̂1l̂} n̂^k̂ n̂^l̂   (electric Riemann, forward-forward)
                                       is nonzero on a set of positive measure in [0,D].
(A2)  Consistency:                     S_L ≈ (1/D) ∫_0^D (1/2) ( -? ) ... = (1/6D) ∫_0^D E_1(s) s^2 w(s/D) ds  (leading)
(A3)  Scale check:                     control parameter   (D/L_curv)^2 = |E_1| D^2 ≪ 1   (Fermi regime valid).

The point of (A2) is that S_L is not an independent number: it is predicted by the integral of the tidal component E_1(s) = R_{1k̂1l̂}n̂n̂. If the directly computed S_L (from ∫√γ_{11}) and the curvature-integral prediction agree to tolerance, the shortening is attributed to curvature, not merely correlated with it. Disagreement means either a bug, a higher-order Fermi term mattering (so (A3) is violated and the object is out of regime), or a residual gauge artifact — every one of which is a downgrade, not a pass.

The invariant scalars {R, R_{μν}R^{μν}, K, C_{μνρσ}C^{μνρσ}} provide the gauge-independent backstop: at least one must be nonzero where S_L is generated (condition C5). A geometry with S_L ≠ 0 but all scalar invariants zero along the ray is, by §5.2's logic, flat-in-disguise — FAIL_COORDINATE_ONLY no matter how S_L was computed. The Weyl scalar C² distinguishes "tidal/vacuum" curvature (Weyl, source-free-able) from "Ricci/sourced" curvature (R_{μν} ≠ 0, requiring matter) — a distinction HC-02 consumes.

6.2 Step B — geodesic-deviation / focusing cross-check (the independent diagnostic)

A second, physically meaningful diagnostic that does not go through L_F at all: the convergence of a bundle of forward-pointing null geodesics through the lobe. The Raychaudhuri equation governs the expansion θ of a null congruence with tangent k^μ:

dθ/dλ = − (1/2) θ^2 − σ_{μν}σ^{μν} + ω_{μν}ω^{μν} − R_{μν} k^μ k^ν .

For a hypersurface-orthogonal (shear-aside) bundle, the focusing term is −R_{μν}k^μk^ν. A genuine forward proper-distance reduction should be accompanied by the right sign of focusing of forward rays:

(B1)  Compute R_{μν} k^μ k^ν for the forward null direction k^μ (built from u^μ + n^μ).
(B2)  Sign/magnitude of induced focusing of the forward bundle must be CONSISTENT with S_L > 0
      (a shortening that focuses forward rays, not one that defocuses them).
(B3)  Cross-check independence: B uses R_{μν} (Ricci, a contraction); A uses R_{1k1l} (a Riemann
      component). They are computed by different code paths from the same g; agreement is a real test.

Worked cross-check on the §5.6 toy. Take the same forward tidal profile E_1(s) = E_0 w(s/D) with E_0 D² = 9.0×10⁻³, which gave S_L ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁵ from path A. Path B is an independent computation: a thin pencil of forward null rays of cross-sectional radius r⊥ accumulates a fractional convergence over lobe depth D. Integrating the (linearized, shear-free) deviation equation d²r⊥/dλ² = −E_1(λ) r⊥ along the ray gives a leading-order fractional focusing

Δr⊥/r⊥ ≈ −∫_0^D (D−s) E_1(s) ds / r⊥-norm = −½ E_0 D² ∫_0^1 (1−σ) w(σ) dσ
∫_0^1 (1−σ) w(σ) dσ = 0.3513…   (raised-cosine window; verified quadrature)
        ⇒ Δr⊥/r⊥ ≈ −½ · 9.0×10⁻³ · 0.351 ≈ −1.58×10⁻³   (rays converge: focusing, correct sign).

Reference computation, not an achieved candidate result. The numeric focusing magnitude above is a marked reference value for the §5.6 toy profile under a leading-order, shear-free, thin-pencil linearization with a stated r⊥-normalization; the second-order deviation terms and the exact pencil normalization are not carried here. It is exhibited only to show sign and order of magnitude. The actual per-candidate focusing number, and the profile-determined ratio below, must be produced numerically in E01b against the certified engine; any discrepancy there is a downgrade, not a tuning knob.

The sign matches a shortening (forward rays converge as the proper distance through the lobe contracts), and the order of magnitude is the same O(E_0 D²) family as S_L. The two numbers are not equal — they are different functionals (S_L weights E_1 by s², the deviation by (D−s)) — so they need not coincide. What a correct engine must reproduce is a fixed, profile-determined ratio S_L / (Δr⊥/r⊥) set entirely by the chosen window w (here, with the marked reference values, ≈ 9.8×10⁻⁵ / (−1.58×10⁻³) ≈ −0.062 — itself a reference number pending E01b's numerical evaluation, not a closure result). A candidate whose A-path S_L and B-path focusing do not share the profile-fixed ratio (to tolerance) has a bug, a gauge artifact, or an out-of-regime expansion — a downgrade, not a pass. This is the substance of "geodesic-deviation signal consistent with S_L": not a slogan, a reproducible cross-check whose number is owed by E01b.

Note a sharp subtlety that the strong closure must respect honestly: R_{μν}k^μk^ν is exactly the quantity the Null Energy Condition bounds — R_{μν}k^μk^ν = M_Pl^{−2} T_{μν}k^μk^ν, so forward focusing of the kind that shortens distance generically demands T_{μν}k^μk^ν < 0 over part of the lobe (NEC violation). HC-01 does not resolve this — it surfaces it. The geodesic-deviation check is precisely where the exotic-energy bill becomes visible, and HC-01's job is to make it visible and hand it to HC-03 (energy/exoticity), not to hide it. A strong-closure path that produced S_L > 0 while silently requiring R_{μν}k^μk^ν < 0 and not flagging it would be FAIL_HIDDEN_EXOTICITY — so the geodesic step is also a tripwire that forces the exoticity question into the open at the earliest gate.

6.3 Step C — sourced stress-energy (the demand handed to HC-02)

HC-01 closure produces the demand T_eff = M_Pl² G_{μν}[g_cand] along the lobe — the stress-energy the candidate geometry requires. The strong closure path's job at this step is only to compute and hand off that demand, with the explicit, contract-mandated caveat:

T_eff is a demand, not a supply (C1.8.3). HC-01 may compute T_eff = M_Pl² G from any metric whatsoever. That a curved lobe "requires" some T_eff is not evidence that the lobe can be sourced. The supply — T_fields from a declared real field action — is computed and matched against T_eff in HC-02, not here. Confusing the demand with the supply is FAIL_UNSOURCED_METRIC, the deepest failure in the program.

So HC-01's source obligation is bounded: emit T_eff, its NEC sign on the forward null direction (T_eff_{μν}k^μk^ν, flagging exoticity), and the source class S0/S1 verdict (no declared source ⇒ TOY_MODEL_UNSOURCED). HC-01 closing with invariant_check = PASS and source_check = AUDIT is the correct, honest terminal state for this challenge — the candidate is a genuine curvature-shortening geometry whose source has not yet been demonstrated to exist. It is TOY_TESTED, never EFT_CANDIDATE.

6.4 Step D — local subluminality (the causality hook handed to HC-04)

The strong closure requires local subluminality: the candidate must not, at the HC-01 level, already exhibit an obviously acausal structure. The minimal HC-01 causality hooks are:

(D1)  Worldline timelike:  g_{μν} u^μ u^ν = −1 < 0 everywhere on z^μ(τ)         [crew moves causally]
(D2)  Lapse positivity:    in the comoving slicing, lapse N(X) > 0 across the lobe [no slice pathology]
(D3)  Forward cone intact: the forward null direction k^μ remains null and future-pointing
                           through the lobe (light cones not tipped past horizontal locally).

These are local, necessary conditions; the full causality analysis (trapped surfaces, CTC proxies, horizon formation, global signalling) is HC-04. The discipline (Build Contract forbidden phrases): HC-01 never states or implies a faster-than-light or "Mars in days" result. The forward proper-distance reduction is a local geometric quantity; whether it integrates to any global travel-time benefit is a separate question, answered negatively as an automatic implication in G3 (the validity-weight theorem proves local S_L does not integrate to a global travel-time cut). HC-01's subluminality hook exists to ensure that a candidate which locally tips the light cones — the signature of a would-be superluminal shortcut — is flagged for HC-04, not waved through.
