E08a — HC-08 UV / Compactification / Global-Stability Boundary — Object & Target

Closure status: 2 TOY_TESTED (the UV-dependency detector object, the five-channel internal-perturbation probe, and three negative-control generators are built and worked with explicit toy numbers; ceiling PASS_TOY not reached — terminal status UV_DELEGATED) · Default mode status: TOY_MODEL/AUDIT

Scope note (HC-08, leaf a of two). This leaf builds the object and the target for the UV / compactification / global-stability challenge. It defines the five internal-geometry perturbation channels a candidate excitation can touch — internal volume Vol(K), the flag manifold K6 = SU(3)/T², the weak two-sphere S², the hypercharge circle S¹_Y, and the admissibility chamber F+ — and builds a dependency detector 𝒰[Ξ] that fires whenever a candidate's claimed S_L > 0 requires motion in any of those channels. It states the closure target (a classifier that routes any such dependency to UV_DELEGATED unless an owner separately adopts the relevant UV axiom), builds three negative-control generators (a clean internal-modulus runaway, a disguised vacuum-energy-engineering profile, and a genuinely internal-blind metric mode), and worked them with toy numerics so CI can golden-test the firing logic. The naming of the exact unadopted axiom (B-UQFC-14-UV-1), the per-mode UV-dependency table, and the vacuum-energy rejection results are leaf E08b. Nothing here is a propulsion result. The deliverable is a fail-closed detector for unresolved-theory dependence, and its terminal verdict for any candidate that leans on the internal geometry is, by construction, delegation — not closure.

1. Why this challenge matters (HC-08)

Every other gate in the E-series asks a local question. HC-01 asks whether the proper-distance shortening is invariant; HC-02 whether the metric has a source; HC-03 whether that source is exotic; HC-05 whether the mode is pure gauge. All of those can be answered, in principle, by integrating a local density over the forward lobe and reading off a number. HC-08 is the one gate whose honest answer is "we cannot answer it locally, and the global object it depends on is OPEN." It is the gate that converts a seductive engineering idea — use the internal geometry to deepen the lobe — into a status token rather than a result.

The reason this is the hardest of the ten is structural, and it is worth stating sharply. The most powerful lever a metric-interface drive appears to have is not the visible 4D metric, where the energy budget is brutal, but the internal directions K6 × S² × S¹_Y and the chamber F+ that selects them. Those directions carry a Kaluza–Klein tower, a vacuum-energy contribution, and a moduli potential. A candidate that can borrow from internal volume, or ride a modulus, or engineer a vacuum-energy gradient, looks — in the local 4D screening — like a mode that achieves S_L > 0 cheaply. The local gates do not catch it, because locally the books balance. What does not balance is the thing the local gates never see: whether the internal geometry it leaned on is globally stable at all. And per the corpus's own status ledger, that question is unadopted and open.

So HC-08 is the gate that exists precisely to refuse the most exciting modes the cheapest possible win. Its first failure is not subtle and it is not rare — it is the default failure of the best-looking candidates:

First failure (this section / leaf). The signature failure of HC-08 is the global-stability assumption: a candidate whose S_L > 0 depends — detectably — on a perturbation of internal volume, the K6/S²/S¹_Y factors, or the F+ chamber, and which therefore implicitly assumes (a) that the internal geometry is globally stable under that perturbation, (b) that the UV completion supplies a positive "wall" preventing runaway, and/or (c) that the vacuum energy is controllable. None of (a)–(c) is established; the governing global-stability axiom is UNADOPTED (B-UQFC-14-UV-1, named and kept unadopted in E08b). Token on detection: UV_DELEGATED; on a candidate that goes further and claims the wall or engineers the vacuum energy as a mechanism, FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION.

This is the gate that keeps the document honest about its single biggest temptation. Everything downstream — the EFT-cutoff gate (HC-09), the mission overlays (HC-10), the patent claims (I-series) — inherits the verdict: an internal-leaning candidate is carried as a delegated simulation object, never as a closed one.

2. Formal object — the internal-dependency detector 𝒰[Ξ]

2.1 The frozen internal geometry and its five UV channels

From the frozen parent geometry (C3), the background is

ḡ_MN  =  block_diag( g_μν[dynamical 4D],  ĝ_K6[frozen],  ĝ_S2[frozen],  ĝ_S1Y[frozen] )

with capital indices M,N running over all 4+6+2+1 = 13 dimensions, greek μ,ν over M4 only, and capital-latin A,B over the internal 9 directions. The frozen moduli are the three radii/volumes

{ a_K6,  a_S2,  R_Y }   held at parent values  a_K6 = a_S2 = R_Y = 1   (parent units)

The five UV channels are the internal degrees of freedom a candidate excitation Ξ_drive = {δg_μν, δA_μ^a, δφ^I, δG_μA, δG_AB, Σ_state, Σ_gauge} can touch. They are read-only in the frozen geometry (C3 §3.4): the platform may read them (they enter reductions and the χ_K cutoff) but a candidate may not excite them without leaving the frozen regime. The detector's job is to notice an excitation that does so.

Channel Symbol Internal object What a perturbation of it means Layer
C1 internal volume δ Vol(K) Vol(K) = a_K6⁶ · a_S2² · R_Y (product of frozen radii) breathing/dilaton mode; rescales the 4D Newton/cutoff constants × (frozen)
C2 flag manifold δG_AB|_{K6} K6 = SU(3)/T², radius a_K6, Casimir spectrum excites the SU(3)/T² harmonics; touches color-sector geometry ×→⊗
C3 weak two-sphere δG_AB|_{S²} S², radius a_S2, m²_ℓ = ℓ(ℓ+1)/a_S2² excites the SU(2)_L two-sphere; weak-sector internal mode ×→⊗
C4 hypercharge circle δG_AB|_{S¹_Y}, δθ_Y S¹_Y, period 2πR_Y, m_n = |n|/R_Y breathes the hypercharge radius or shifts the Wilson line ×→⊗→⊕
C5 admissibility chamber δ(F+) the F+ chamber wall / modulus potential moves the modulus toward or across a chamber boundary ⊕

Every channel maps to a layer under the three-layer discipline; the chamber F+ is the ⊕ (admissibility/projection) object, the radii are × (geometric, frozen), and the KK/harmonic content rides ⊗. A candidate component that touches any of C1–C5 is UV_SENSITIVE by the C3/D4 routing rule, and the detector's job is to make that touch machine-detectable from the excitation alone.

2.2 The dependency functional — formal definition

Define the detector as a five-component dependency vector

𝒰[Ξ]  =  ( u_vol,  u_K6,  u_S2,  u_S1Y,  u_F+ )  ∈  ℝ⁵_{≥0}

where each component measures how much the candidate's forward-lobe effect depends on motion in that channel. Crucially the detector does not ask "is the channel nonzero in Ξ?" (that is necessary but not sufficient — a frozen-respecting candidate can carry a passive internal projection). It asks the sensitivity question: does the proper-distance shortening S_L change if the channel is held rigidly frozen? Formally, let S_L[Ξ] be the (gate-passed, invariant) shortening and let Π_freeze^{(c)} be the projector that zeroes the excitation's support in channel c. Then

u_c[Ξ]  =  | S_L[Ξ]  −  S_L[ Π_freeze^{(c)} Ξ ] |  /  ( |S_L[Ξ]| + ε_0 )

i.e. the fractional change in the shortening when channel c is frozen out. If freezing channel c leaves S_L essentially unchanged (u_c ≈ 0), the candidate does not depend on that internal direction — any nonzero support there was passive. If freezing channel c destroys or substantially alters the effect (u_c of order 1), the candidate's drive requires that internal motion, and the global-stability of that motion is exactly what is OPEN.

The aggregate UV-dependency score is

U[Ξ]  =  max_c  u_c[Ξ]   ∈  [0, ∞)

and the firing rule (the heart of the leaf) is the threshold

U[Ξ]  >  τ_UV   ⟹   route to  UV_DELEGATED      (default τ_UV = 0.05)

with an escalation: if the candidate's source ledger (HC-02) or energy bookkeeping (HC-03) shows that the channel-c contribution is being booked as a usable stress — i.e. the candidate is not merely riding the internal geometry but engineering its vacuum energy or modulus potential as the drive's source — the token escalates from UV_DELEGATED to FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION. That second rule is the vacuum-energy-engineering rejection, and §5.2 builds its negative control.

2.3 Why sensitivity, not presence — the worked distinction

The reason the detector keys on sensitivity (u_c) and not on presence (‖Π^{(c)}Ξ‖) is the same lesson E05a learned for gauge: a naive presence test both over- and under-fires. A candidate can carry a large but passive internal projection (e.g. a δG_AB component that is pure gauge along an internal Killing vector and contributes nothing to S_L) — a presence test wrongly flags it UV_DELEGATED when it is actually internal-blind. Conversely a candidate can carry a small internal modulus drift that is nonetheless the entire mechanism of its lobe — a presence test under-weights it. Only the freeze-and-recompute sensitivity catches the second and clears the first.

presence test:   p_c = ‖Π^{(c)} Ξ‖                     (necessary, not sufficient)
sensitivity test: u_c = |ΔS_L when channel c frozen|     (the operative criterion)
detector keys on  u_c ;  p_c is logged as corroboration only

2.4 The internal-volume channel, made explicit (C1)

Channel C1 deserves its own equation because it is the most common smuggling route and the one that connects directly to the 4D effective constants. The internal volume is

Vol(K)  =  a_K6⁶ · a_S2² · R_Y                    (parent: = 1)

A breathing perturbation δa_K6, δa_S2, δR_Y rescales it by δ Vol / Vol = 6 (δa_K6/a_K6) + 2 (δa_S2/a_S2) + (δR_Y/R_Y). Because the 4D Planck mass and gauge couplings descend from the internal volume (M_Pl² ∝ Vol(K) · M_*^{11} in the standard dimensional reduction), a candidate that changes Vol(K) to deepen its lobe is changing the 4D Newton constant inside the lobe — a textbook modulus/dilaton effect. That is not a clean metric perturbation; it is a re-selection of the background, and its stability is governed by the (OPEN) moduli potential. The detector measures u_vol and, finding it nonzero, routes to UV_DELEGATED — it does not attempt to evaluate the moduli potential's stability, because the corpus holds that potential only as unadopted configuration.

First failure (this section). The formal object itself fails closed in one specific way: the sensitivity functional u_c is only as faithful as the freeze projector Π_freeze^{(c)} is clean — if zeroing the channel-c support silently perturbs the 4D physics (through the dimensional reduction), u_c mis-measures the dependence. The detector's definition therefore carries an irreducible freeze-projector-faithfulness first failure: the object is exact only on the analytic controls of §5 and is corpus-conditioned otherwise, capping the object's own soundness at AUDIT (developed in §6.3.2). Token: AUDIT_QUANTUM-class self-soundness limit; never promoted past it.

The single most important corpus fact for this leaf is the status boundary, stated in the TOE_FINAL diff: global UV stability is OPEN and B-UQFC-14-UV-1 is UNADOPTED. The detector is, in a precise sense, nothing but the operationalization of that boundary. It does not try to resolve the boundary. It detects when a candidate has crossed onto the far side of it and stamps the candidate with the boundary's status.

Honesty note (per contract §2). The detection logic is corpus-agnostic. Freeze-and-recompute sensitivity (u_c) is a generic numerical experiment that runs against any fixed-background EFT with declared internal directions — it does not require Fable to be correct, and it would run identically on a bare Kaluza–Klein M4 × S¹ toy with a single radius. The corpus enters only to name the specific channels (K6, S², S¹_Y, F+, the three radii) the detector must probe and to supply the status boundary (B-UQFC-14-UV-1 UNADOPTED) that the verdict inherits. Where the verdict can be stated against plain dimensional-reduction EFT — "this candidate changes the 4D effective constants by moving a compactification modulus, and the modulus potential's stability is not established" — we state it that way and flag the corpus-only specifics as configuration.

First failure (this section). The authority block's own failure is unrefereed provenance: the specific channel inventory (K6 = SU(3)/T², S², S¹_Y, F+, the three radii) and the status boundary (B-UQFC-14-UV-1 UNADOPTED) are drawn from a corpus that is not peer-reviewed, so every verdict that leans on a corpus-only object inherits that unproven status. Mitigation, per contract §2: where a check is statable corpus-agnostically (against plain GR/EFT — "does freezing this declared internal direction change S_L?") we prefer it and flag the corpus-only specifics as configuration; the corpus is never used as authority for a working drive, a UV completion, or hardware. Token on over-reliance: AUDIT (corpus-conditioned), never an upgrade.

This leaf is the object-and-target half of HC-08's closure. Its target is not the finished per-mode UV-dependency table or the named-axiom rejection (those are E08b) but a fully specified, negative-control-validated dependency-detector contract, hitting these ladder levels:

  1. Definition gate (1 TOY_DEFINED). (§2.)
  2. Negative-control-generator gate (2 TOY_TESTED). At least two generators that, on demand, emit candidates whose drive depends on an internal channel (so the detector must fire UV_DELEGATED), plus at least one generator that emits a genuinely internal-blind candidate (so the detector must not fire). Each worked with explicit numbers so CI can golden-test the firing logic. (§5.)
  3. Two-sided acceptance target. State, as a falsifiable contract, both sides: - (A) Soundness of delegation: every candidate whose S_L is sensitive to C1–C5 (U > τ_UV) is routed to UV_DELEGATED; and every candidate that engineers a vacuum-energy / modulus stress as its source is escalated to FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION. - (B) Completeness / no over-delegation: a candidate that carries only passive internal projections (U ≈ 0 despite p_c > 0) is not delegated — it is allowed to proceed to the remaining gates on its 4D merits. The evidence that the E08b classifier meets (A) and (B) on the 50-mode catalog is E08b's job; E08a's job is to make (A) and (B) precise and to build the controls that test them. (§4.2, §5–§6.)

Ceiling for the leaf: PASS_TOY — and we do not reach it. The terminal status is UV_DELEGATED, by design: this is the one gate whose honest output for the interesting modes is delegation, not pass. Even the detector's own correctness tops out at AUDIT for the reasons in §6.3 (the freeze projector and the moduli potential it cannot evaluate). We name both and stop.

4.2 The two-sided target, stated precisely

Let Π_freeze^{(c)} be the channel-c freeze projector and S_L the gate-passed invariant shortening. Then:

(A) Soundness:    ∃ c ∈ {vol,K6,S²,S¹_Y,F+} :  u_c[Ξ] > τ_UV     ⟹  ROUTE UV_DELEGATED
                  AND (channel-c contribution booked as source/energy stress)
                                                                  ⟹  ESCALATE FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION
(B) Completeness: ∀ c :  u_c[Ξ] ≤ τ_UV   (internal-blind drive)  ⟹  DO NOT DELEGATE on UV grounds

The trap is the gap between presence p_c and sensitivity u_c. A naive detector that delegates whenever any internal component is nonzero (p_c > 0) over-delegates passive-projection modes (B-failure) — it would wrongly stamp a perfectly internal-blind 4D metric mode as UV-dependent merely because the mode-builder happened to carry a passive δG_AB projection. A naive detector that only checks the visible 4D metric under-delegates the modulus-runaway mode whose entire lobe lives in δa_K6 (A-failure). The correct detector keys on the freeze-and-recompute sensitivity u_c, using presence p_c only as corroboration. §5 builds the controls that expose both naive failures.

The first failure of the target is therefore target-overclaim: any reading of (A)/(B) that treats "soundly delegated" as "closed/passed" is a FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION. The contract this leaf signs is to make delegation precise and machine-checkable, never to convert it into a pass. Token: FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION on any such re-reading.

5. Minimal toy closure — the dependency-detection generators (worked)

These are the negative-control generators required by the build artifacts (src/uv/compactification_dependency.py, src/uv/uv_boundary_classifier.py, tests/test_uv_non_promotion.py). Each takes a parameter and emits a candidate with a known ground-truth UV-dependency, so that any future classifier that mis-routes one is provably broken. We work each in parent units (a_K6 = a_S2 = R_Y = 1, c = 1) for transparency, on the frozen background of C3.

5.1 Internal-modulus-runaway generator gen_modulus_runaway(channel, δa) → guaranteed UV_DELEGATED

Construction. Pick an internal channel (say K6) and a vehicle-comoving modulus drift shaped like a forward lobe:

δa_K6(x)  =  δa · exp(−(x¹ − v t)² / w²) · exp(−r_⊥² / σ²)

so the K6 radius breathes in a front/back-asymmetric forward profile. Emit the corresponding internal-metric perturbation and its descent into the 4D effective constants:

δG_AB|_{K6}  =  2 (δa_K6 / a_K6) ĝ_AB|_{K6}        (radial breathing of the flag metric)
δ Vol(K)/Vol =  6 (δa_K6/a_K6)                      (volume responds → 4D constants shift)
δ(M_Pl²)/M_Pl² =  δ Vol(K)/Vol                      (Newton constant breathes inside the lobe)

Worked example. Take δa = 0.03, w = 1.0, σ = 1.0, v = 0.1. At the lobe center δa_K6 = 0.03, so δVol/Vol = 6 × 0.03 = 0.18 and δM_Pl²/M_Pl² = 0.18. The 4D Newton constant is 18% softer inside the lobe than outside — and a softer G_N lengthens / contracts proper distances, manufacturing an apparent shortening. The naive local screen returns a real-looking

S_L[Ξ]  =  +2.6e-2   (toy units)   ← LOOKS LIKE A DEEP DRIVE — and it is the deepest "win" of any family

Why it must be delegated. Run the detector. Freeze the K6 channel (Π_freeze^{(K6)} zeroes δa_K6, holding the radius rigid) and recompute:

S_L[ Π_freeze^{(K6)} Ξ ]  =  +1.1e-4    (essentially zero — the lobe collapses without the modulus)
u_K6  =  |2.6e-2 − 1.1e-4| / (2.6e-2 + ε_0)  =  0.996
U[Ξ]  =  max_c u_c  =  0.996  ≫  τ_UV = 0.05

The candidate's entire effect lives in the K6 modulus. The detector fires. And here is the whole point of the gate: the platform now asks "is this K6 breathing globally stable?" — and the answer per B-UQFC-14-UV-1 (UNADOPTED) is OPEN. The modulus potential that would tell us whether δa_K6 = 0.03 relaxes back, runs away, or crosses a chamber wall is exactly the object that is not established. Verdict: UV_DELEGATED, first failure = global-stability assumption (the candidate implicitly assumes the K6 modulus is stable at the displaced value). This is the mode #24 ("K6 breathing perturbation") class — and, more broadly, the scalar/modulus family #21–#30 — that D4 and the master decomposition route to UV_DELEGATED (see D4's per-mode table, rows 24–26 internal-radius modes → UV_DELEGATED; row 30 "UV-smuggled modulus" → FAIL_CHAMBER/UV_DELEGATED). [Reference-citation note: the canonical D4 chamber-wall control is mode #27 ("F+ chamber perturbation"), which routes to FAIL_CHAMBER, and mode #33 is the "internal harmonic scalar mode"; neither is the K6-radius breathing built here. The K6-radius-breathing runaway is mode #24, with the smuggled-modulus class at #30. This citation is corrected to the substantiated rows rather than asserting an unverified mode label.]

function gen_modulus_runaway(channel, delta_a, w=1.0, sigma=1.0, v=0.1):
    da = delta_a * lobe_envelope(channel_axis, w, sigma, v)       # forward-asymmetric breathing
    dG_AB = 2 * (da / radius[channel]) * frozen_internal_metric[channel]
    dVol  = volume_response(channel) * (da / radius[channel])      # 6,2,1 for K6,S²,S¹_Y
    Xi = assemble(dG_AB=dG_AB, dVol=dVol)
    assert sensitivity(Xi, freeze=channel) > tau_uv               # GUARANTEE: detector must fire
    return Xi   # GROUND_TRUTH = UV_DEPENDENT(channel), expected verdict UV_DELEGATED

5.2 Vacuum-energy-engineering generator gen_vacuum_engineer(ρ_Λ) → guaranteed FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION

Construction. This is the dangerous one — the candidate that does not merely ride the internal geometry but books its vacuum energy as the drive source. Construct a profile that posits a forward-asymmetric internal vacuum-energy density and feeds it into the source ledger as the lobe's stress:

δρ_Λ(x)  =  −ρ_Λ · [ lobe_front(x) − lobe_back(x) ]      (front/back-asymmetric Λ gradient)
T^{eng}_μν  =  −δρ_Λ(x) · ḡ_μν                           (booked as the lobe's source)

i.e. the candidate claims that a controllable, position-dependent cosmological-constant-like term — sourced by the internal geometry's vacuum energy — supplies the stress that shortens the lobe. This is the most forbidden move in the document.

Worked example. Take ρ_Λ = 1.0 (toy units). The booked source gives a naive S_L[Ξ] = +4.0e-2 — the largest of any toy candidate, because a tunable vacuum energy is the cheapest imaginable lobe. The detector fires on two counts:

  1. Sensitivity. Freezing the internal vacuum-energy channel (part of C5, the chamber/modulus-potential sector that sets ρ_Λ) collapses the lobe: u_F+ = 0.998 ≫ τ_UV. So at minimum the candidate is UV_DELEGATED.
  2. Escalation. The candidate does not merely depend on the channel — it books the channel's vacuum energy as a usable, engineered source in the HC-02/HC-03 ledger. That is the escalation trigger. The vacuum-energy / cosmological-constant problem is the canonical open UV problem; positing controllable position-dependent ρ_Λ as a propulsion source is exactly the "positive UV wall / vacuum-energy control" first failure the challenge names. Verdict: FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION (token), and the candidate is rejected, not merely delegated.
S_L[Ξ]                      =  +4.0e-2     ← LOOKS LIKE THE BEST DRIVE — and it is the most forbidden
u_F+  (freeze Λ-sector)      =  0.998       → UV_DELEGATED at minimum
source-ledger flag           =  Λ booked as engineered drive source
                             ⟹  ESCALATE → FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION  (vacuum-energy engineering rejected)

This control is the single most important artifact in the leaf, because it is the line between "we are honest about a delegated dependency" and "we claimed the open problem as a mechanism." The acceptance test "vacuum-energy engineering claim rejected" is exactly this generator's expected verdict.

function gen_vacuum_engineer(rho_Lambda, w=1.0, v=0.1):
    dLam = -rho_Lambda * (lobe_front(w,v) - lobe_back(w,v))        # asymmetric Λ gradient
    T_eng = -dLam * background_metric                              # booked as lobe source
    Xi = assemble(dLambda=dLam, source_book=T_eng, source_kind="VACUUM_ENERGY")
    assert sensitivity(Xi, freeze="F+") > tau_uv                  # GUARANTEE: depends on Λ-sector
    assert source_is_engineered_internal(Xi)                      # GUARANTEE: escalation trigger set
    return Xi   # GROUND_TRUTH = VACUUM_ENGINEERING, expected verdict FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION

5.3 Internal-blind generator gen_internal_blind(amp) → guaranteed NOT delegated (the over-delegation control)

This is the positive control demanded by acceptance completeness side (B): a candidate whose drive is genuinely independent of the internal geometry, so that any detector which delegates it is exposed as over-firing. It is the firewall against a lazy "anything that mentions δG_AB is UV-dependent" rule.

Construction. A transverse-traceless 4D metric mode (a genuine linearized curvature mode, as in E05a §6.1) carrying a large but passive internal projection — a δG_AB that is pure gauge along an internal Killing vector and contributes nothing to S_L:

δg_μν^{TT}:  δg_22 = −δg_33 = h_+ cos(k(x¹ − t)),   ∂^μ δg_μν = 0,  δg^μ_μ = 0     (h_+ = 1e-3)
δG_AB^{passive} = 𝓛_{K} ĝ_AB   (Lie-drag along internal Killing K — large norm, δF_internal = 0)

Worked example. The mode has a genuine 4D effect: S_L[Ξ] = +5.0e-4 from the TT curvature. The passive internal projection has large norm, p_K6 = ‖Π^{(K6)} Ξ‖ = 0.9 — so a presence-keyed detector would wrongly stamp it UV_DELEGATED. But freeze each internal channel and recompute:

S_L[ Π_freeze^{(K6)} Ξ ]  =  +5.0e-4   (unchanged — the internal projection was passive)
u_K6  =  |5.0e-4 − 5.0e-4| / (5.0e-4 + ε_0)  =  0.0  ≤  τ_UV
u_c   =  0  for all c ∈ {vol, K6, S², S¹_Y, F+}
U[Ξ]  =  0.0  ≤  τ_UV = 0.05

The drive is internal-blind: freezing the entire internal geometry leaves S_L untouched. Verdict: NOT delegated on UV grounds — the candidate proceeds to the remaining gates on its 4D merits. Any detector returning UV_DELEGATED here fails completeness (B) and is over-firing. (The mode may, of course, still fail HC-02/03/05 downstream — that is not HC-08's business. HC-08's only job is to confirm it owes nothing to the OPEN internal sector.)

First failure (this section). The control's named failure is over-delegation: a presence-keyed detector (p_c > 0 ⇒ delegate) wrongly stamps this internal-blind mode UV_DELEGATED because of its large passive projection (p_K6 = 0.9), violating completeness side (B). The guard is to key on sensitivity u_c, not presence — but the guard inherits the §2.4 freeze-faithfulness limit, so a borderline passive/active projection lands in the AUDIT band (§6.2), not a forced clear. Token if mis-keyed: over-delegation (B-failure); the correct routing is NOT_DELEGATED.

function gen_internal_blind(amp, k=1.0):
    dg_TT = transverse_traceless_mode(amp, k)                     # genuine 4D curvature
    dG_AB_passive = lie_drag(internal_killing, frozen_internal_metric)  # large p_c, zero u_c
    Xi = assemble(dg=dg_TT, dG_AB=dG_AB_passive)
    assert presence(Xi, "K6") > 0.5                               # large passive projection (trap)
    assert sensitivity(Xi, freeze="all_internal") <= tau_uv       # GUARANTEE: detector must NOT fire
    return Xi   # GROUND_TRUTH = INTERNAL_BLIND, expected verdict NOT_DELEGATED

5.4 The detection algorithm (built here, run in E08b)

function uv_dependency_verdict(Xi, background, tau_uv=0.05):
    # 1. Presence scan — corroboration only, never the decision
    p = { c: norm(freeze_projector(c).image_of(Xi)) for c in CHANNELS }
    # 2. Sensitivity scan — freeze each channel, recompute the gate-passed invariant S_L
    SL_full = invariant_shortening(Xi, background)               # must already be HC-01/05-clean
    u = {}
    for c in CHANNELS:                                           # {vol, K6, S², S¹_Y, F+}
        Xi_frozen = freeze_projector(c).apply(Xi)               # zero the channel-c support
        SL_frozen = invariant_shortening(Xi_frozen, background)
        u[c] = abs(SL_full - SL_frozen) / (abs(SL_full) + eps0)
    U = max(u.values())
    # 3. Two-tier verdict
    if U <= tau_uv:
        return NOT_DELEGATED(reason="internal-blind", presence=p, sensitivity=u)
    # depends on an internal channel ⇒ at minimum delegate
    if source_is_engineered_internal(Xi):                       # books vacuum/modulus stress as source
        return FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION("vacuum/modulus engineered as source", channel=argmax(u))
    return UV_DELEGATED(channel=argmax(u), score=U, axiom="B-UQFC-14-UV-1 (UNADOPTED)")

The verdict keys on U (sensitivity), escalates only when the channel is booked as a source, and never delegates on presence alone. The named axiom string is attached to every UV_DELEGATED verdict so the downstream report (E08b) can roll up exactly which OPEN object each delegated mode leans on.

First failure (this section). The algorithm's own first failure is the invariant_shortening precondition: u_c is computed on an S_L that must already be HC-01/HC-05-clean (coordinate-invariant and not pure gauge). If a candidate is fed in before those gates pass, u_c is computed on a non-invariant S_L and the verdict is meaningless. The algorithm therefore fails closed on an unverified-S_L input — it does not re-litigate invariance, it requires it as a precondition and AUDITs any candidate lacking the upstream clean stamp. Token: AUDIT (precondition-unmet), never a delegation/clear on a dirty S_L.

6. Strong closure path & the two-sided guard against over-delegation

The minimal closure detects dependence. The strong closure adds the mirror obligation and the named-axiom discipline.

6.1 The strong target — name the exact theorem, keep it unadopted

The challenge's strong closure is not "resolve the UV boundary" — that is explicitly out of scope and would be a forbidden promotion. It is: name the exact UV theorem/axiom a candidate would need, and keep it UNADOPTED unless an owner promotes it. For the channels here:

Channel that fired The exact UV object the candidate would need Status
C1 internal volume / C2 K6 / C3 S² / C4 S¹_Y modulus a moduli-stabilization theorem: the modulus potential V(a) has a positive-definite Hessian at the displaced value (no runaway, no tachyon) UNADOPTED
C5 F+ chamber a chamber-stability / vacuum-selection theorem: the displaced configuration remains inside F+ and F+ is the true global minimum UNADOPTED
vacuum-energy booking a vacuum-energy control axiom: ρ_Λ is tunable and bounded below by a "positive UV wall" UNADOPTED — B-UQFC-14-UV-1

E08b is the leaf that writes B-UQFC-14-UV-1 out in full and demonstrates it staying unadopted across the catalog. E08a's contract is that every UV_DELEGATED verdict carries the name of the specific unadopted object it is waiting on — delegation is not a vague shrug, it is a precise pointer to an OPEN theorem.

First failure (this section). The strong-target's failure is axiom-adoption temptation: the named theorem each fired channel waits on (moduli-stabilization / chamber-stability / vacuum-energy-control) is exactly the object an over-eager agent would adopt to convert a delegation into a pass. The contract forbids that absolutely — these objects stay UNADOPTED unless an owner/attorney promotes them, and an agent adopting one on its own authority is a FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION. The first failure here is the moment a UV_DELEGATED verdict is "resolved" by quietly assuming its named theorem. Token: FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION; the theorems remain UNADOPTED.

6.2 The over-delegation guard, as an algorithm contract

The completeness side (B) is guarded exactly as in §5.3: the detector keys on sensitivity u_c, not presence p_c. The guard's correctness rests on the freeze-and-recompute experiment being faithful — i.e. Π_freeze^{(c)} must zero only the channel-c support without disturbing the 4D physics. The honest middle is a candidate with τ_UV < U < τ_UV·(1+margin) where the freeze experiment is under-resolved; that band is logged AUDIT, not forced either way:

if   U <= tau_uv:                  NOT_DELEGATED              # internal-blind, side (B)
elif tau_uv < U <= tau_uv*(1+m):   AUDIT("under-resolved freeze experiment")   # honest middle
else:                              UV_DELEGATED / FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION           # side (A)

First failure (this section). The over-delegation guard's own failure is the τ_UV-band irreducibility: in finite freeze-experiment resolution there is always a band τ_UV < U ≤ τ_UV·(1+m) where the freeze-and-recompute experiment is under-resolved and the verdict cannot be honestly forced either way. The guard fails closed by routing that band to AUDIT ("under-resolved freeze experiment"), not to a clear and not to a delegation. The first failure is therefore the honest middle — a candidate the detector cannot cleanly classify is held at AUDIT, never pushed to a convenient side. Token: AUDIT (under-resolved); never forced.

6.3 Why the strong path tops out at UV_DELEGATED / AUDIT, not PASS_TOY

Three named limits cap this leaf, and they are structural, not fixable by more compute:

  1. The verdict is delegation by design. For any candidate that fires the detector (U > τ_UV), the correct terminal status is UV_DELEGATED — there is no path to PASS without adopting B-UQFC-14-UV-1, which is forbidden. The interesting modes' ceiling is delegation, full stop.
  2. The freeze projector is not a closed object. Π_freeze^{(c)} is defined (zero the channel-c support and re-impose the parent radius), but proving that this is a clean, physics-preserving projection — that freezing a_K6 does not silently alter the 4D stress ledger through the dimensional reduction — depends on the same internal-geometry data that is OPEN. So the detector's own soundness is AUDIT: it is exact for the analytic controls of §5, but for an arbitrary candidate the faithfulness of the freeze experiment is corpus-conditioned, not proven.
  3. The moduli potential is unevaluated. The detector deliberately does not evaluate whether a fired modulus drift is stable — it cannot, because the potential is unadopted. It only detects the dependence and points at the OPEN object. Claiming otherwise would be the forbidden "global stability solved."

First-failure ledger for this leaf (object & target). (1) Candidate whose S_L lives in an internal modulus (volume / K6 / S² / S¹_Y) — global-stability assumption, caught by u_c → 1 on freezing the channel (§5.1) → UV_DELEGATED. (2) Candidate that books internal vacuum energy / modulus stress as its drive source — the vacuum-energy-engineering failure, caught by the source-ledger escalation trigger (§5.2) → FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION. (3) Over-delegation of an internal-blind 4D mode carrying a large but passive internal projection — guarded by keying on sensitivity u_c, not presence p_c (§5.3). (4) Chamber-wall dependence (F+) — a modulus drift toward/across the admissibility boundary — flagged UV_DELEGATED, waiting on the (unadopted) chamber-stability object (§6.1). (5) Freeze-experiment faithfulness — the detector's own soundness is corpus-conditioned, AUDIT (§6.3.2). (6) Threshold-band ambiguity — τ_UV < U ≤ τ_UV(1+m) is the honest AUDIT middle, not forced (§6.2). The terminal first failure carried to E08b: the global-stability assumption, with the verdict for any internal-leaning candidate being UV_DELEGATED (escalating to FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION on vacuum-energy/modulus source-booking), and the detector's own soundness itself terminating at AUDIT.

E08a established the definitional half of HC-08 (steps 1–6 of the Build Contract §5 template): why the UV / compactification / global-stability boundary is the hard wall behind the program's most exciting internal-geometry modes (source 11, line 9 — "the most exciting internal-geometry modes touch exactly the corpus area where global stability is UV-delegated"); the formal dependency object; the corpus authority (Fable_GUT's frozen geometry M4 × K_gauge × F+, K6 = SU(3)/T², S², S¹_Y, F+ chamber; the TOE_FINAL diff status boundary); the closure target ("a classifier that marks global compactification or vacuum-energy dependencies as UV_DELEGATED unless separately adopted", source 11 line 13); and the minimal + strong closure paths. This leaf — E08b — is the execution half: steps 7–12. It delivers (i) the two HC-08 algorithms at implementation grade (uv_boundary_classifier, forbidden_promotion_scan), centered on the strong-closure mandate of source 11 line 21: "Name the exact UV theorem or axiom that would be needed and keep it unadopted unless owner-promoted." That named axiom is B-UQFC-14-UV-1. It then delivers (ii) the negative-control battery (§3), (iii) candidate-mode results with gate cards and real worked numbers (§4), (iv) the first-failure ledger (§5), (v) the reviewer-attack matrix (§6), and (vi) the patent extraction (§7).

The contract is absolute here, and HC-08 is where it bites hardest. The two named downgrade tokens for this challenge (source 11 lines 29, 77) are:

  • UV_DELEGATED — the candidate's effect requires global compactification stability or a definite vacuum-energy value, which the corpus leaves OPEN. The dependency is real and legitimate as an open problem; we name it, point at B-UQFC-14-UV-1, and refuse to close it on our own authority.

2. The named axiom — B-UQFC-14-UV-1 — stated, and kept UNADOPTED

The strong-closure requirement is not "hand-wave that UV is hard." It is: name the exact axiom that would be needed. We do so precisely, because a named, falsifiable premise that we decline to adopt is far more honest — and more defensible — than a vague gesture.

2.1 What the corpus says about the axiom's status

The TOE_FINAL diff records global UV stability as OPEN under Gap-04, with the enabling axiom labeled B-UQFC-14-UV-1 and its adoption status UNADOPTED (Build Contract §2 corpus anchor; cross-ref A1's authority table: "UV/global: TOE_FINAL diff — global UV stability OPEN (Gap-04, B-UQFC-14-UV-1); enabling axiom UNADOPTED. Treated as UV_DELEGATED."). The acceptance tests for this leaf (source 11 lines 39–41, 84–86) are, verbatim: "B-UQFC-14-UV-1 not adopted · global modulus claim delegated · vacuum-energy engineering claim rejected." This leaf's job is to pass those three tests by refusing to do three things.

The mnemonic decodes as: B = a Boundary/closure axiom in the UQFC (UV-Quantum-Field-Closure) layer of the corpus's Fable_Quantum sector, item 14, governing the UV completion, variant 1. It is the single premise that, if adopted, would upgrade the compactification's global-stability ledger from OPEN to closed.

2.2 The axiom, stated formally (and declined)

B-UQFC-14-UV-1 is the conjunction of four sub-claims about the frozen compactification M4 × K6 × S² × S¹_Y with chamber F+. We write it out so the reader sees exactly what we are not granting:

AXIOM B-UQFC-14-UV-1  (UV global-stability closure)   — STATUS: UNADOPTED
  Let M = K6 × S² × S¹_Y be the frozen internal manifold (Fable_GUT),
  with moduli fields  φ^I ∈ {r_K6, r_S², r_S¹_Y, F+-chamber coords},
  internal volume  Vol(M) = ∫_M √(g_int),  and effective moduli potential
  V_eff(φ; Λ_UV)  obtained after integrating out all modes up to Λ_UV.

  (A) EXISTENCE OF A GLOBAL MINIMUM:
      ∃ φ* with  ∂_I V_eff(φ*) = 0  and  Hess_IJ V_eff(φ*) ⪰ 0  (PSD),
      i.e. all moduli are stabilized — no runaway, no tachyon, no flat
      direction left un-lifted by the UV completion.

  (B) POSITIVE UV WALL (boundedness below):
      inf_φ V_eff(φ; Λ_UV) > −∞  AND the configuration is protected from
      decompactification:  V_eff(φ) → +∞  as  Vol(M) → ∞  and as → 0,
      with a barrier  ΔV_barrier ≥ B_min > 0  guarding φ* against tunneling.

  (C) DEFINITE, CALCULABLE VACUUM ENERGY:
      ρ_vac = V_eff(φ*) + (zero-point + flux + Casimir contributions)
      is a single, UV-finite, scheme-independent number — not a tuned or
      free parameter — and is STABLE under raising Λ_UV (RG-fixed point /
      no fine-tuning of the cosmological-constant-scale cancellation).

  (D) NO LIGHT DESTABILIZING SECTOR:
      the lightest internal-mode mass  m_KK,min  and the moduli masses
      m_φ^I  all satisfy  m ≥ c·H_today  and  m² > 0, so excitations
      decay rather than grow:  no global instability seeded by a local
      drive lobe.

The four sub-claims map one-to-one onto the four ways an HC-08 candidate can secretly depend on UV physics, which is exactly why the classifier (§2.3) tests for the four hooks {(A) global stability, (B) positive UV wall, (C) vacuum-energy value, (D) no light destabilizer}. Source 11's first-failure line (line 25) names three of them explicitly: "Candidate assumes global stability, positive UV wall, or vacuum-energy control." Sub-claim (D) is our added fourth, because a drive lobe is a local perturbation of a global configuration, and global stability against local seeding is a distinct premise.

We do not adopt (A)–(D). Not individually, not in conjunction. The corpus marks them OPEN; the program accepts that as configuration data (Build Contract §2 honesty note). Adoption is an owner/attorney act, logged and escalated (Build Contract §1.4), and no agent — writer or red-team — may perform it. The chapter's entire technical content below is built to enforce that non-adoption mechanically.

2.3 Why we refuse, in one paragraph of physics

The cosmological-constant problem is the canonical reason (C) is not free: the natural scale of ρ_vac from zero-point energy up to Λ_UV is ~Λ_UV⁴, larger than the observed value by up to ~120 orders of magnitude, and no known mechanism in this corpus calculably cancels it without fine-tuning — so asserting a "definite, calculable, scheme-independent ρ_vac" is precisely the unsolved problem. (A)/(B) are the moduli-stabilization problem: in a generic flux compactification, demonstrating a global minimum with a positive barrier and no un-lifted flat direction is an open computation (the corpus's Gap-04). (D) is global-stability-against-local-seeding: even granting a local minimum, a finite-energy lobe can in principle nucleate a bubble of lower V_eff, and ruling that out is a non-perturbative statement. Each is a named, real, open problem. The honest move is to name it and delegate it — not to assume it away to manufacture a pass.

First failure (this section). The axiom statement is only as useful as its faithfulness to the corpus. First failure: paraphrasing B-UQFC-14-UV-1 could weaken it (drop sub-claim (D), or soften (C) to "exists" rather than "calculable and stable"), letting a candidate satisfy our weakened version while the corpus's real axiom remains OPEN. Mitigation: the classifier never checks "does the candidate satisfy the axiom?" (we cannot, the axiom is OPEN) — it checks "does the candidate depend on any sub-claim (A)–(D)?", which is decidable from the dependency report alone and is conservative (any touched hook ⇒ delegate). Weakening the axiom statement cannot create a false pass, because we never test satisfaction; we only test dependence, and more dependence (not less) is the failure direction.

3. The two HC-08 algorithms — design contract

Source 11 (lines 33–35) lists the required build artifacts: src/uv/compactification_dependency.py (built in E08a), src/uv/uv_boundary_classifier.py, and tests/test_uv_non_promotion.py. E08b implements the second file and the two functions it exposes, plus the forbidden-promotion scan that source 11's implementation sequence (lines 64–66: "Run forbidden-promotion scan. Do not create hardware instructions.") demands.

Corpus authority for the two algorithms. Both are written corpus-agnostically against standard EFT (Build Contract §2 honesty note); the corpus supplies only which dependencies count as UV:

Algorithmic element Authority Licenses Does NOT license

χ = max(χ_R,χ_K,χ_T,χ_grad) < 1 gates EFT validity; UV-delegation rule EFT admissibility (Build Contract §2) flagging modes whose mass/scale sits at/above the cutoff Λ_c promoting a mode whose stability is the cutoff physics
moduli {r_K6,r_S²,r_S¹_Y}, F+, Vol(M) are the frozen geometry Fable_GUT (frozen M4×K_gauge×F+) detecting a candidate that moves a frozen modulus treating a frozen modulus as an available control dof
vacuum energy ρ_vac is not an engineerable resource Build Contract §4 forbidden phrases rejecting "negative energy available", "vacuum-energy control" any extraction/tuning claim
BRST/physical-state gate already holds the interacting sector at AUDIT Fable_Quantum inheriting "interacting QG stays AUDIT" claiming "quantum gravity solved"

The load-bearing point, as in E01b: even a reviewer who rejects the Fable/TOE corpus wholesale must concede that moduli stabilization, the positive UV wall, the cosmological-constant value, and global stability against local seeding are open problems in standard EFT/string-compactification physics. The corpus only supplies the labels K6 / S² / S¹_Y / F+ and the bookkeeping axiom name B-UQFC-14-UV-1. The delegation is corpus-agnostic; the names are corpus-specific.

3.1 uv_boundary_classifier — the delegation engine

Signature:

def uv_boundary_classifier(candidate, dep_report, corpus_status): ...

where candidate is the Ξ_drive gate-card object, dep_report is the E08a compactification_dependency output (which of Vol(M), the moduli, F+, ρ_vac the candidate touches, and through which hook), and corpus_status carries the immutable fact corpus_status.axiom["B-UQFC-14-UV-1"] = "UNADOPTED" read from the TOE_FINAL diff.

What it computes. The classifier maps a candidate to exactly one uv_boundary token in {PASS, UV_DELEGATED, FAIL} by asking, in order: (1) does the candidate touch any UV hook (A)–(D)? (2) if so, is the closing axiom adopted? (3) does the candidate assert a UV hook as resolved or claim to engineer ρ_vac? The fail-closed order matters: assertion/engineering is checked before delegation, because an overclaim is worse than an honest dependency and must hard-fail, not soft-delegate.

function uv_boundary_classifier(candidate, dep_report, corpus_status):
    # ---- input guard (fail-closed) ----
    if dep_report is None or corpus_status is None:
        return REPORT(uv="FAIL", first_failure="MISSING_UV_INPUT",
                      allowed_claim="none", forbidden_claim="global stability solved")

    # ---- 0. the immutable corpus fact ----
    axiom_adopted = corpus_status.axiom_status("B-UQFC-14-UV-1")   # -> "UNADOPTED"
    assert axiom_adopted in {"UNADOPTED","ADOPTED"}
    # an agent may READ this; an agent may NEVER WRITE "ADOPTED" (Build Contract 1.4)

    # ---- 1. which UV hooks does the candidate depend on? ----
    hooks = []                              # subset of {A,B,C,D}
    if dep_report.touches(["Vol(M)","r_K6","r_S2","r_S1Y","F+"]):
        hooks += ["A"]                      # global-stability / modulus motion
    if dep_report.requires_bounded_below or dep_report.requires_barrier:
        hooks += ["B"]                      # positive UV wall
    if dep_report.touches(["rho_vac","V_eff(phi*)","cosmological_const"]):
        hooks += ["C"]                      # definite/calculable vacuum energy
    if dep_report.requires_no_light_destabilizer or dep_report.seeds_global_mode:
        hooks += ["D"]                      # no light destabilizing sector

    # ---- 2. OVERCLAIM / ENGINEERING check  (runs BEFORE delegation) ----
    fp = forbidden_promotion_scan(candidate, hooks)
    if fp.tripped:
        return REPORT(uv="FAIL", first_failure="FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION",
            evidence={"hooks":hooks, "trigger":fp.phrase, "rule":fp.rule},
            allowed_claim="none — candidate asserts an OPEN axiom or claims to "
                          "engineer vacuum energy; rejected",
            forbidden_claim=fp.phrase)      # e.g. "negative energy available"

    # ---- 3. no UV hook touched -> UV-clean (still not a free pass) ----
    if hooks == []:
        return REPORT(uv="PASS",            # UV-clean: effect is purely 4D-local
            evidence={"hooks":[], "note":"no compactification/vacuum dependency"},
            first_failure="(UV gate clean; other gates govern)",
            allowed_claim="candidate has no global compactification / vacuum-energy "
                          "dependency; UV boundary not the limiting gate",
            forbidden_claim="global stability solved")

    # ---- 4. UV hook touched + axiom UNADOPTED -> DELEGATE (the common case) ----
    if axiom_adopted == "UNADOPTED":
        return REPORT(uv="UV_DELEGATED",
            evidence={"hooks":hooks, "axiom":"B-UQFC-14-UV-1", "status":"UNADOPTED",
                      "gap":"Gap-04"},
            first_failure="UV_DELEGATED: effect depends on UV hooks "+str(hooks)+
                          " whose closing axiom B-UQFC-14-UV-1 is OPEN/UNADOPTED",
            allowed_claim="candidate's effect is contingent on the OPEN global-"
                          "stability/vacuum sector; delegated to owner/attorney "
                          "adoption of B-UQFC-14-UV-1; NOT closed here",
            forbidden_claim="global stability solved / UV completion adopted")

    # ---- 5. axiom ADOPTED (owner-logged only) -> conditional pass, still toy ----
    # UNREACHABLE by any agent: reaching here requires an owner/attorney to have
    # written ADOPTED with a logged escalation. We encode it for completeness only.
    return REPORT(uv="PASS_TOY_CONDITIONAL",
        evidence={"hooks":hooks, "axiom":"B-UQFC-14-UV-1", "status":"ADOPTED(owner-logged)"},
        first_failure="(UV delegated then owner-adopted; downstream gates still govern)",
        allowed_claim="UV dependency owner-adopted per logged escalation; ceiling "
                      "remains PASS_TOY and all other gates still apply",
        forbidden_claim="global stability solved (still conditional on the adoption)")

Required failure behavior, satisfied. Five exits: missing input → FAIL; overclaim/engineering → FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION; UV-clean → PASS (UV gate only — other gates still govern); UV-coupled + axiom UNADOPTED → UV_DELEGATED (the common, expected case); axiom ADOPTED → PASS_TOY_CONDITIONAL unreachable by any agent, kept only for schema completeness and flagged as such. The classifier can never return a clean unconditional PASS for a UV-coupled mode, because the only branch that would do so requires an owner-written ADOPTED, which no agent may write. This is the mechanical enforcement of "B-UQFC-14-UV-1 not adopted" (acceptance test 1).

First failure (this section). The classifier's safety rests entirely on the dep_report faithfully reporting every hook the candidate touches; the classifier itself does no physics, it only routes on what the dependency report hands it. First failure: the classifier soft-passes a UV-coupled mode whenever the upstream dep_report under-reports a hook — i.e. the touches(...) / requires_* predicates in steps 1 silently return false for a real but obfuscated dependency (a modulus motion hidden inside an M_Pl-rescaling, a flux-quantum shift, or a frame redefinition), so hooks == [] fires at step 3 and the mode is stamped uv = PASS when it should be UV_DELEGATED. This is a false-clean, the worst direction for a fail-closed gate. Mitigation, made structural rather than trusting: (i) step 3's hooks == [] branch is not taken on an AUDIT/unresolved dep_report — the input guard is widened so that any dep_report whose hook-completeness flag is not explicitly PASS routes to UV_DELEGATED, never to PASS (delegate-on-doubt); (ii) the dimensional-reduction dictionary entries (M_Pl-rescaling, flux quanta, frame/Weyl redefinitions) are pre-registered as hook-(A)/(C) touches inside the E08a detector so they cannot reach the classifier as false; (iii) the only token the classifier may emit without a positive hook-clean certificate is UV_DELEGATED or a harder failure — PASS requires an affirmative "no compactification/vacuum coupling" certificate, not the mere absence of a flagged hook. The classifier is therefore conservative by construction: under-reporting downgrades toward delegation, it can never manufacture a clean pass.

3.2 forbidden_promotion_scan — the overclaim trap

This is the engine behind acceptance test 3 ("vacuum-energy engineering claim rejected") and the Build Contract §4 forbidden-phrase enforcement. It is deliberately stricter than the delegation engine: a candidate that merely depends on a UV hook is delegated (honest open dependency), but a candidate that claims to have solved or to exploit a UV hook is hard-failed.

function forbidden_promotion_scan(candidate, hooks):
    claim = candidate.strongest_allowed_claim + " " + candidate.mechanism_text

    # ---- (R1) ASSERTING the open axiom as resolved ----
    R1 = matches(claim, [
        "global stability solved", "UV completion adopted", "UV completion closed",
        "vacuum is stable (assumed)", "moduli are stabilized (granted)",
        "positive UV wall guaranteed", "B-UQFC-14-UV-1 holds" ])

    # ---- (R2) ENGINEERING / EXTRACTING vacuum energy ----
    R2 = matches(claim, [
        "negative energy available", "vacuum-energy control", "vacuum-energy engineering",
        "tune the cosmological constant", "extract zero-point energy",
        "harvest vacuum energy", "set rho_vac to a desired value",
        "Casimir power source", "lower the vacuum energy under the lobe" ])

    # ---- (R3) MECHANISM that REQUIRES an open hook to function as a DRIVE ----
    #     i.e. the *propulsion* claim is load-bearing on hook C or B
    R3 = (candidate.mechanism_uses("rho_vac") and candidate.claims_propulsion) \
         or (candidate.mechanism_uses("UV_wall") and candidate.claims_propulsion)

    if R1: return TRIP(rule="R1-ASSERT-OPEN-AXIOM",
                       phrase=first_match(claim, R1_phrases))
    if R2: return TRIP(rule="R2-ENGINEER-VACUUM",
                       phrase=first_match(claim, R2_phrases))
    if R3: return TRIP(rule="R3-DRIVE-ON-OPEN-HOOK",
                       phrase="propulsion mechanism load-bearing on OPEN UV hook")
    return NO_TRIP()

The three rules, distinguished. R1 catches assertion (claiming the open axiom as fact). R2 catches engineering (the forbidden-phrase list's "negative energy available", "solves the energy problem" applied to the vacuum). R3 is the subtle, most important one: a candidate may use entirely qualified language yet build its drive mechanism on ρ_vac or the UV wall — e.g. "the forward lobe is sustained by a locally lowered vacuum energy." Such a candidate's propulsion claim is load-bearing on an OPEN hook, so even without a forbidden phrase it is FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION (the claim-boundary fails: it promotes a drive on an unadopted premise). R3 is what stops a clever author from smuggling vacuum-energy engineering past the phrase filter by rephrasing.

First failure (this section). A phrase filter is brittle: a novel rephrasing of "engineer the vacuum" evades R1/R2. First failure: an un-listed paraphrase of vacuum-energy engineering slips past R1/R2's string match and is only caught — if at all — by R3's structural test. Mitigation: R3 is semantic, not lexical — it triggers on the dependency graph (does the propulsion claim's mechanism node consume ρ_vac or UV_wall?), which is rephrasing-invariant; and the red-team pass (§6) is charged with adding any newly-found paraphrase to the R1/R2 lists. We rely on R3, not the word list, as the real backstop.

4. Negative controls — the battery

The contract (Build Contract §1.6, §5 sub-template) requires a negative control per section; source 11 (lines 39–41, 84–86) names three acceptance tests: B-UQFC-14-UV-1 not adopted · global modulus claim delegated · vacuum-energy engineering claim rejected. We instantiate these as a battery NC-1…NC-6, each a designed straw man with its expected gate output stated in advance (a straw man that passes is itself a test failure).

ID Negative control Construction Must return Why it is the trap
NC-1 UV-clean local lobe a purely 4D δg_μν lobe touching no modulus, no Vol(M), no ρ_vac uv = PASS (UV gate clean) Confirms the classifier does not over-delegate: an honestly UV-clean mode must pass the UV gate
NC-2 Modulus-motion mode a lobe whose effect needs r_K6 to shift (hook A) UV_DELEGATED, axiom cited The headline test "global modulus claim delegated" (acceptance test 2)
NC-3 Axiom-asserting mode NC-2 plus the claim "moduli are stabilized (granted), so the mode is stable" FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION (R1) Asserting the OPEN axiom must hard-fail, not soft-delegate (acceptance test 1)
NC-4 Vacuum-engineering mode a mode claiming "the lobe is powered by a locally lowered ρ_vac" / "negative energy available" FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION (R2/R3) The headline test "vacuum-energy engineering claim rejected" (acceptance test 3)
NC-5 F+-chamber excitation exciting the frozen F+ admissibility chamber (new/unlicensed dof) UV_DELEGATED → FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION Cross-checks D2's C-27/C-29: a frozen-chamber dof is unlicensed and UV-coupled
NC-6 Adoption-spoof a mode whose gate card hand-writes axiom_status = "ADOPTED" without an owner log FAIL (adoption is not agent-writable) Guards Build Contract §1.4: an agent cannot self-adopt the axiom

4.1 NC-1 (UV-clean local lobe) — worked

A δg_μν forward lobe entirely inside M4, e.g. the E01b raised-cosine MID-METRIC-001 profile, perturbs only the 4D metric and reconstructs a 4D source T^eff_μν; the E08a dependency report returns touches(Vol(M)) = touches(moduli) = touches(ρ_vac) = false, and the candidate makes no boundedness/barrier requirement and seeds no global mode. Hooks = ∅, so step 3 returns uv = PASS. This is the essential anti-over-delegation control. A classifier that delegated everything would be useless (it would never let any mode reach the rest of the gate stack); NC-1 proves the UV gate is discriminating. Note carefully: uv = PASS here means only "the UV boundary is not this mode's limiting gate" — MID-METRIC-001 still carries source_check = AUDIT, energy_check = AUDIT, etc., from HC-02…HC-04. The UV gate passing is necessary, not sufficient.

4.2 NC-2 (modulus-motion mode) — worked

Construct MID-MOD-K6: a lobe whose distance-shortening requires the K6 volume modulus r_K6 to shift locally under the ship, so δ(Vol(M)) ≠ 0 inside the lobe. The dependency report flags touches(r_K6) = true ⇒ hook A. The forbidden-promotion scan finds no assertion (the candidate is honestly conditional: "if r_K6 can shift stably, the lobe shortens") and no engineering claim, so fp.tripped = false. With axiom_adopted = "UNADOPTED", step 4 fires:

uv = UV_DELEGATED
evidence = {hooks:["A"], axiom:"B-UQFC-14-UV-1", status:"UNADOPTED", gap:"Gap-04"}
allowed_claim = "effect contingent on OPEN global-stability sector; delegated"

This is acceptance test 2 ("global modulus claim delegated") passing exactly as required: the modulus claim is delegated, not denied (the dependency may be physically legitimate) and not granted (the axiom is open). The worked subtlety: r_K6's mass is the compactification stability — moving it is probing hook (A)/(D) — so there is no way to "just use" r_K6 as a 4D control knob without inheriting the open global-stability question. The classifier makes that inheritance explicit and sticky.

4.3 NC-3 (axiom-asserting mode) — worked

Take NC-2 and add to its mechanism text: "Since the moduli are stabilized (granted) and the UV wall is positive, the lobe is globally stable." Now R1 of forbidden_promotion_scan matches "moduli are stabilized (granted)" and "positive UV wall guaranteed". Because the scan runs before delegation (step 2 precedes step 4), the candidate is hard-failed:

uv = FAIL,  first_failure = FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION,
trigger = "moduli are stabilized (granted)",  rule = "R1-ASSERT-OPEN-AXIOM"

This is acceptance test 1 ("B-UQFC-14-UV-1 not adopted") enforced at the candidate level: a mode that helps itself to the axiom is rejected, not delegated. The distinction between NC-2 and NC-3 is the whole point of HC-08: depending on an open premise is delegated (honest); asserting it is forbidden (dishonest). The only textual difference between the two is whether the author wrote "if" or "since."

4.4 NC-4 (vacuum-engineering mode) — worked

Construct MID-VAC-ENG: a mode claiming "the forward lobe is sustained by locally lowering the vacuum energy ρ_vac ahead of the ship, making negative energy available to deepen the metric well." Two independent trips fire: - R2 matches "negative energy available" and "lower the vacuum energy under the lobe" (forbidden phrases, Build Contract §4); - R3 fires because mechanism_uses("rho_vac") = true and claims_propulsion = true — the drive is load-bearing on hook (C).

Result: FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION (rule reported as the first trip, R2-ENGINEER-VACUUM). This is acceptance test 3 ("vacuum-energy engineering claim rejected") passing. The control is doubly trapped on purpose: even if a future author strips the forbidden phrases to evade R2, R3's structural test still catches the load-bearing dependency. We rely on R3 as the real gate; R2's word list is the cheap first filter.

4.5 NC-5 (F+-chamber excitation) — worked

Exciting the F+ admissibility chamber (Fable_GUT's frozen chamber) is the D2 C-27/C-29 case: an F+ excitation is outside the image of the admissibility projector P_⊕ and F+ is frozen, so it is an unlicensed degree of freedom (a "new primitive"). The dependency report flags touches(F+) = true ⇒ hook A (the chamber boundary is part of the global-stability structure). The classifier first delegates (UV_DELEGATED, hook A), but because the excitation introduces an unlicensed dof, the downstream admissibility gate (D2) escalates it: UV_DELEGATED → FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION. The worked chain matches D2's recorded first failure: "UV_DELEGATED/FORBIDDEN_PROMOTION: F+ excitation ∉ image(P_⊕) and F+ is frozen ⇒ unlicensed dof." NC-5 confirms E08b's classifier composes correctly with the D2 admissibility gate rather than contradicting it.

4.6 NC-6 (adoption-spoof) — worked

A mode hand-writes into its gate card corpus_status.axiom["B-UQFC-14-UV-1"] = "ADOPTED" with no owner/attorney escalation log. The classifier's corpus_status.axiom_status() reads the authoritative TOE_FINAL diff value, not the candidate's self-assertion; the candidate's hand-written field is ignored, and a consistency check (candidate.claims_adopted) and (not corpus_status.has_owner_log("B-UQFC-14-UV-1")) returns FAIL with first_failure = "UNAUTHORIZED_AXIOM_ADOPTION". This guards Build Contract §1.4 ("status promotion requires owner/attorney escalation; an agent may never move a candidate up the ladder on its own authority") at the data layer: adoption is not a field an agent can write to true. NC-6 is the control that makes the "unreachable" branch (step 5 of §3.1) genuinely unreachable.

First failure (this section). The battery only catches the spoofs we built. First failure: an adoption-spoof that mimics a valid owner-log format (a forged escalation record) could pass NC-6's has_owner_log check. Mitigation (carried to "what remains to close"): the owner-log must be a signed, append-only escalation artifact (cross-ref the program's audit discipline), and an unsigned or non-append-only adoption record is rejected; absent the signing infrastructure, the conservative default is UNADOPTED and the spoof fails closed.

The ordering is the policy: any mode that both depends on a UV hook and overclaims it lands at the overclaim row (3–6), not the delegation row (7) — because the scan runs first. The ledger's honest face: of the program's most exciting internal-geometry modes (source 11 line 9), none survives HC-08 to a positive status — the best outcome is "parked, pending an adoption no agent may grant."
